plants.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Viele stellen die Beziehung zwischen Smaragdschirm und Rubinschirm in Frage. 'Wir sind Brüder!' verkündet Rubinschirm selbstbewusst und klopft auf sein Vordach. Mein lieber älterer Bruder macht gerade eine schwere Zeit durch.</color>
plants.info:
<size=34>Reflektiert die Geschosse von Zombies.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Eine Variante des Smaragdschirms. Man kann mit Melonapulten und Kohlapulten zwischen beiden wechseln. Aegis verliert die Fähigkeit, geworfene Geschosse zu buffen, erhält aber jetzt eine Schadensreduzierung von 90% und kann Zombie-Geschosse reflektieren.</color></color>

plants.name: Charmetronpilz
plants.introduce: <size=34><color=black></color>Mit der Kraft der Liebe und Freundschaft würde sogar ein verrottender Zombie mit unschlagbarem Herzen zu unserem besten Freund und größten Verbündeten werden! Nun ja, das und eine große Menge verdächtiger, bewusstseinsverändernder Sporen, die ausgerechnet von Magneten angetrieben werden und <b>DEFINITIV<b> für den menschlichen Kontakt unbedenklich sind. Nun ja, zumindest für den Moment …
plants.info:
<size=32><color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/2 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Die Geschosse haben einen Spritzradius von 1 Feld, ohne abzufallen, und können nicht von Zombies konsumiert werden. Das Füttern mit Metallgegenständen gewährt 1 Ladungsstufe für 30 Sekunden, bis zu 2 Ladungen. Bei 1 Ladestufe gibt sie 2 Schüsse pro Angriff ab, bei 2 Ladestufen 4 Schüsse. Jede Pflanze, die sich im selben Magnetkraft-System befindet, erhöht den Schaden ihrer Schüsse um 5%.</color>
<color=black>Odyssee Verbesserung:
<color=#8B0000>1. Die HP-Schwelle, um Zombies zu verzaubern, wurde von 50% auf 100% erhöht
2. Jetzt immer in einem voll aufgeladenen Zustand | Angriffsintervall → 1 Sekunde</color>

plants.name: Obsidianmine
plants.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Obsidian-mine possesses immense power despite its size. He fears no zombies. However, it has its troubles, as block people with diamond pickaxes often come to knock on its head.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Has extremely high toughness and can block Diggers.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>32000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Subspecies of Obsidian Tall-nut. You can switch between the two with Potato Mine or Tall-nut. Blocks Digger Zombies and release a small potato-nut explosion for every 1000 damage received (before damage reduction), dealing 500 damage to zombies in a small area.<size=36><color=black>

plants.name: Katznessel
plants.introduce: <size=36><color=black>"I think it's better to use animal hair to keep myself above water than relying on, for example, a swim ring!" Magicat Nettle stands by her belief. Hmm... If you think this is due to her poor academic skills and inability to stay afloat on the river, you're right. How could a cat possibly swim! Though she refuses to be categorized randomly.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Summons drones to attack every time she defeats a zombie.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>160x2/1.5 Seconds, for each zombie killed summons a small floating drone on the same row, firing 30 nettle spikes with 100 damage each.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>The more zombies there are, the fewer zombies there will be (inherits Neko Squash's trait of refunding cards upon zombie kills)</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Basic Attack Damage x5.
2. Drone Attack Damage x3.</color><size=36><color=black>

plants.name: Titan-Apokalerbsen-Geschützturm
plants.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Titan Apeacalypse Turret rarely interacts with people. It's not due to arrogance, but because people keep asking whether the fire on his body is hot or cold, and whether he can <page>create hot ice or cold fire. These questions bore him.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Consumes HP to fire obsidian pelts that knock back enemies and becomes stronger the longer he shoots.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120 per shot</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Shots knock back zombies and pierce twice, with power halved per pierce. Fires faster as HP decreases and reaches maximum speed when below 1/3 HP. If HP is further reduced, attack damage increases. Damage is capped at 480 at 0 HP. <page>Each shot fired inflict 50 self-damage until HP is reduced to 1500. </color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Defense increases as HP decreases. Below 100 health, it becomes immune to damage under 100.
2. Increases projectile damage and knockback significantly.</color><size=36><color=black>

plants.name: Schicksalspilz
plants.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Everyone wonders how Calamity-shroom subdues massive creatures to serve her. Endless destruction should bring silence... When questioned, she sits alone atop a tower, sipping her dreamy brew: "Oblivion? No, I simply grant them rebirth within illusions."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Turn the tide of battle!

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Charms zombies in range (same as Doom-shroom) and makes them explode upon death, dealing damage like Doom-shroom.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Doom-shroom explosions now leave no craters.
2. Summons 3 charmed Armored Gargantuars upon explosion. Each charmed zombie summons a Zomboni too.</color><size=36><color=black>

plants.name: MG-Sonnenpustepilz
plants.introduce: <size=36><color=black>"Production is also part of the fight!" said Gatling Sunburst-shroom, wiping its sweat. Its platoon has been reorganized into the 'Sunshine Bay Construction Corps,' but their fighting spirit remains undiminished.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Generates a large amount of sun for you.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20x4x3/1.5 Seconds</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Subspecies of Gatling Icicle-shroom. You can switch between the two with Ice-shroom or Sunflower. Shots no longer slow but instead drop 5 sun on hitting the 1st and 2nd zombies. Each subsequent pierce deals double the damage but requires 5 sun per hit. Synergizes with the sun value doubling Odyssey Modifier and dropped suns are worth 15 each when the effect is active.</color><size=36><color=black>

plants.name: MG-Rasereipilz
plants.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Compared to the composed demeanor of Gatling Doom, Gatling Frenzy-shroom has a much shorter temper, especially when someone calls her a "Gray Egg". She often yells "Quietus!" and charges into the fray.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Continuously fires Doom-shroom attacks at zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300, attack interval shortens by 0.1 seconds per attack, to a minimum of 0.25 seconds.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Subspecies of Gatling Doom. You can switch between the two with Peashooter or Scaredy-shroom. Fires a large bullet of doom every 16 attacks, dealing 1800 damage. When the "bullets of doom every round" effect is active, fires a large bullet of doom every 4 attacks and explodes when zombies are near regardless of attack speed.</color><size=36><color=black>

plants.name: Obsidian-Wall-Nuss
plants.introduce: <size=36>
plants.info:
<size=36>A sub-species of Spikesidian.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>16000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Counters any damage received back to the zombie that inflicted it. Recovers 1500 Robustheit per 15 Seconds. Benefits from Spikesidian's Modifiers.</color>

plants.name: Wirtschaftsholz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Though still a small child, Tycoonwood returned from abroad with a showman's flair. His "turn a stone into gold" trick had audiences roaring with delight. Backstage, as he stirred a mysterious drink, he smirked and whispered, "It's kind of magic, actually."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Turns all straight-shooting bullets into coin bullets!

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Converts all ordinary straight-shooting bullets encountered into 2 Silver Coins and 1 Gold Coin.
<color=black>•</color> Gold Coins will move in a straight line. Silver Coins will split to the top and bottom rows initially then join the Gold Coins in the middle row after 0.5s.
<color=black>•</color> Silver Coins will deal 50% of the original bullet's damage and return 10 coins when hitting zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Gold Coins will deal 100% of the original bullet's damage and return 30 coins when hitting zombies.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. 1% Damage increase to Coin projectiles for every 1000 Coins you have
2. Tycoonwood's projectiles now deal splash damage | Magnate Plantern Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Dornimator
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thornminator is one of the top hairstylists in town, revolutionizing botanical fashion with every masterpiece she crafts. "Real style takes real work," she says, twirling a carving knife between her fingers. Hammers and chisels may not be traditional hairstyling tools, but for her, they're essential for "fixing" even the most stubborn strands.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires Doom-hypno Ice Spikes. When planted, unleashes a barrage of Doom-hypno Ice Spikes.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Doominator</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each projectile inflicts chill and adds 20 Cryo points. Deals ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Doominator. 
<color=black>•</color> Attacks pierce infinitely, prioritizes air units.
<color=black>•</color> Has a chance to hypnotize zombies and cause explosive damage—same effect as Doominator.
<color=black>•</color> When planted, scatter-shoots at most 80 Doom-Hypno Spikes, targeting both air and ground enemies.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Attack damage ×3
2. Zombies take damage equal to 30% of their current HP each time they are defrozen</color>

plants.name: Luz del Kohl
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Sun God—lord of light and warmth, the eternal ruler of the heavens. Wherever he treads, darkness fades, and life flourishes under his radiant embrace. Suspended high above the firmament, his indomitable glow pierces the void, casting away despair and igniting hope in all who bask in his presence.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Summons a Mini Sun to attack zombies.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300×5/2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits the traits of Solar-pult.
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Mini Sun every 30s. The Mini Sun lasts for 15s and deals 60+(40×Amount of Helios Cabbages) damage to all zombies every 0.5s.
<color=black>•</color> When Sun exceeds 15k, consumes 200 Sun to inflict triple the damage each time the Mini Sun damages zombies.
<color=black>•</color> When the Mini Sun is present, the drop rate of Sun in the level is greatly increased (once every 0.75s), and Meteors now deal 2× damage and drop 250 Sun (except Helios Meteor).</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Costs 1000 Coins; if there is no Mini Sun on the field, summon it immediately. Otherwise, extend the duration of the Mini Sun by 15s. Only one Mini Sun can exist at a time.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. When Sun exceeds 15k, each attack consumes 0.5% of the excess to boost projectile damage by 20 per 1 Sun spent
2. Mini Sun deals 3× damage</color>

<color=black>Magnetar Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Magnetar and Helios Cabbage's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> With at least 10 Magnetars and 10 Helios Cabbages on the field, Magnetars summon a Helios Meteor instead, and the Mini Sun from Helios Cabbage no longer disappears and deals 5× damage.
<color=black>•</color> Helios Meteor: (1800 + 1800 × Magnetars) × (1 + 0.2 × Helios Cabbages) Damage, and drops 1250 Sun.</color>

plants.name: Allzweckkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After a full-scale mechanical overhaul, Omni Pumpkin was a fortress on wheels. Composite armor? Check. Iron reinforcements? Double check. Tactical interface? You bet. Everything was perfect... until he caught a glimpse of his reflection. A crab. They turned him into a crab. "Guys, seriously?! A little heads-up would've been nice!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A pumpkin with many functions.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color>
<color=#8B0000>Metal Plant. Has a multitude of traits.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Jack-in-the-Box explosions and protects the plants inside as well.
<color=black>•</color> Forces Digger Zombies to come out of the ground early.
<color=black>•</color> Halves damage from Cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> You can use metal objects on it to heal it by 500.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers: </color>
<color=#8B0000>1. On entry, grants all connected Magnetic Plants a Shield equal to 30 × number of Magnetic Plants
2. Now counts twice towards the number of Magnetic Plants</color>

plants.name: Radianter Topf
plants.introduce: Deep in the garden, where the sun always shines, Radiant Pot stands in quiet devotion. He doesn't chatter, nor does he boast—he simply gives, weaving sunlight into golden coins, waiting patiently for you to grow as radiant as he is.
plants.info:
<size=36>Can quickly generate a lot of Sun and Coins.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Special:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Produces 50 Sun and 300 Coins every n=(Current Sun/1000) Seconds, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 15.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Golden Pot's Ultimate-syncing ability.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Upgrade costs from Silver Pots to Golden Pots will not exceed 8000
2. Coins exceeding the maximum amount will be converted into Sun at a rate of 2:1</color>

plants.name: Pharos' Schirm
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once the beloved director of the Plant Orphanage, she was more than just a caretaker—she was family. Her broad leaves were the perfect playground for young sprouts, offering shade, comfort, and joy. Though those days have passed, her kindness remains. "Oh? Would you like to try this marshmallow, my boy?" she asks, her warmth as enduring as ever.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Shoots lasers to attack zombies.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Energy Limit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Search Range: </color><color=#8B0000>(2×Lumos Level+1) Rows</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> It has all the traits of Lumos Umbrella.
<color=black>•</color> Fires lasers to attack zombies, dealing 100% damage every second. Prioritizes air zombies, and deals ×3 damage to air targets. Can attack up to 4 zombies at a time.
<color=black>•</color> Every 2s, consumes up to 10% max energy to heal up to 2 injured plants in a 3×3 area for 5% max HP (max 500). Healing increases by 100% per Lumos Level beyond 1.
<color=black>•</color> When two Pharos Umbrellas are positioned one above and one below, they will link together, and their detection range will expand to cover the entire screen. In this state, the two Pharos Umbrellas can simultaneously attack up to 6 zombies, and their damage is doubled. Additionally, if exactly 6 zombies are being attacked, a 3×3 explosion will occur at the location of a random zombie every 6s, dealing 300% of the attack power as damage.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Energy Limit ×10, Recovery Speed ×20, Healing Speed ×2 | Boreas Umbrella Subspecies Unlocked
2. Normal Attack Damage ×3, Explosion Damage ×10, Attack Interval → 2s</color>

plants.name: Gierpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"They told her not to open it. Naturally, she opened it." Avarice-shroom ran a finger along the ornate lid, gilded and humming faintly with temptation. Whispers spilled from within—hunger, envy, ambition—all begging to be set free. With a smile too knowing to be innocent, she lifted the seal. What emerged wasn't hope. It was profit. "Welcome, little monster," she whispered, as the abyss stirred and a new fortune clawed its way out.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>She can summon Mini-boss zombies!

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Calamity-shroom's Modifier</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Calamity-shroom.
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Mini-boss Zombie depending on the scene:
Day: Professor Cherryz | Night: Giga Football Striker | Pool: Jackson Worldwide | Fog: Skystrider Mecha | Roof Day: Pozeidon | Roof Dusk: Clown Jill-in-the-Box | Roof Night: Ultra Mecha-nut
<color=black>•</color> At the same time, summons its ordinary Odyssey variant on all rows.
<color=black>•</color> Defeating the Mini-boss Zombie gives you a ton of Sun, Coins, and points.
<color=black>•</color> Defeating an ordinary Odyssey variant gives you 1 Plant Giftbox.
<color=black>•</color> It can only be summoned once per round. This plant will not spawn from a Plant Giftbox.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Avarice-shroom Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Kirschkanonendrohne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Originally developed as a rapid-fire prototype for the Gatling Cherrybomber, Cherrybomber Drone was recently upgraded to fire real cherry rounds to combat the zombie surge—earning explosive acclaim.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Provides enhanced firepower when coordinated with shooter plants directly below.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Gatling Cherrybomber</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Hovering plant and Subspecies of Gatling Cherrybomber.
<color=black>•</color> If the plant directly below attacks faster than every 1.5s, its attack synchronizes with that plant's.
<color=black>•</color> Maximum number of Cherrybomber Drones on the lawn: (number of lanes×2)</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Explosive cherries from plants ×3 damage
2. Attack Interval halved</color>

<color=black>SP Gatling Frenzy-shroom Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Gatling Cherrybomber and Gatling Doom's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> When Cherrybomber Drone and SP Gatling Frenzy-shroom are on the same tile, they perform coordinated attacks, and the former gains 0.05 energy while the latter gains 0.1 energy. Energy drains at 0.3 per second. For the first 7 whole points of energy, each increases the number of shots fired during coordinated attacks by 1. Energy above 7 increases the 8th bullet’s damage by ×(1 + excess point).</color>

plants.name: Napalmpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Napalm-Shroom isn’t just fire on the battlefield—his BBQ skills are legendary. His dream? To host the greatest barbecue party ever, with every plant and zombie in town invited.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs Napalm melons that split on impact and leave behind an inferno.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>3000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/6s + 30/0.02s (Inferno)</color>
<color=#720026>Enflamed Debuff: </color><color=#8B0000>Each melon creates an inferno zone that lasts for 2.5s.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Range: 4 tiles; Manual launch: full board. After launching a Napalm melon, rests for 1.5s, then charges up for at least 6 seconds, increasing damage to 1+(charge time in seconds×50%) to a max of 30s.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks pierce all armor and split into 2 additional Napalm melons that target nearby zombies with the same damage.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Charging speed and max charging duration ×3
2. Inferno zone duration ×2</color>

plants.name: Captang Goldbeard
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Since sailin' back from the Abyss, Kelptain Goldbeard be a changed beast - fiercer, greedier, an' twice as hearted. Captain o' the cursed ship, the Raidin' Goldplant, he bears two hearts, one torn from his own breast, t'other plundered from a fallen rival, and clutches a gilded giftbox stuffed with plunder from the Seven Seas. Touch his hearts or his treasure, an' yer ship sinks straight to Davy Jones' Locker.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Greedy overlord of the seven seas, capable of squeezing every last drop of value from zombies.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s + Insta-kill (Drown) × ∞</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Retains all traits of Hydra Kelp, but can drag zombies underwater an infinite amount of times (up to once per second).
<color=black>•</color> Zombies hit by its projectiles turn golden—when they die, they grant ×3 Odyssey points. Max bonus: +2000 points per wave.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Plants deal 5% more attack damage for every 1000 points owned (up to +300%)
2. The Odyssey shop now has a 30% discount on Modifiers</color>

plants.name: Eisenerbsenpilz-Trio
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Buck-shrooms' worst fear finally came true—they really did get stuck to a Magnet-shroom, and no one's been able to pull them off. But maybe it’s a blessing in disguise. With all the materials the Magnet-shroom collected, they've upgraded their gear and become a true "Steel Battalion."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A multi-purpose squad skilled in rapid fire, anti-air, and sniping!

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>6000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80×4/1s (Machine gun); 240/2s (Flak cannon); 400/3s (Sniper)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant. 
<color=black>•</color> Machine gun rounds knock back targets and deal additional damage based on the current HP of their Type 2 armor.
<color=black>•</color> The flak cannon targets only air units in its lane, dealing knockback and same-tile splash damage.
<color=black>•</color> The sniper attack shares the same traits as Snipea.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Sniper always headshots with a 1/3 chance to trigger rapid-fire, but attack CD increased to 7.5s
2. Flak cannon knockback ×2, splash damage ×3 | Buck-strike Squadron Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Mais Planck
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>He was born at the dawn of the universe, his age beyond reckoning. From the primordial void, he plucked three stars to orbit him as moons—treasures not even black holes could steal. Now, the old one finds joy in toying with this cosmic keepsake, as ancient as he is.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Hurls ultra-dense black holes that collapse into explosions, releasing all the absorbed energy.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/2 s (Mini Butter)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant.
<color=black>•</color> 75% chance to launch Mini Butter, shrinking non-miniboss zombies' size and HP to 70%. If shrinking fails, the target is stunned for 1.5s. Instantly kills imp-class zombies.
<color=black>•</color> 25% chance to launch an Ultimate Black Hole that lasts 2s, slows nearby zombies, and absorbs Quantum McCornics' projectiles in a 3×3 area.
<color=black>•</color> Each bullet absorbed adds 2s to its duration, up to 7.5s. When it vanishes, it triggers a large explosion (Cherry Bomb-sized) that deals 320 + 60% of stored damage. If it lasted over 5s, the explosion radius significantly increases.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Ultimate Black Hole can absorb all projectiles
2. Ultimate Black Hole's absorption radius ×2</color>
<color=black>Maelonstrom Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Quantum McCornics and Maelonstrom's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> Hail melons from Maelonstrom's Nebula Rifts now deal 6× damage and create Singularities, and Quantum McCornics always lob Ultimate Black Holes.
<color=black>•</color> Singularity: Lasts for 3.5s and deals 1800 Cremator damage in a 1.5-tile radius when it collapses.
<color=black>•</color> When an Ultimate Black Hole collapses, it also detonates all Singularities to further increase its own damage.</color>

plants.name: Tesla-Magnet
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tesla Magnet commands iron with thunder and thunder with magnetic fields. He grants his people eternal magnetism and built a kingdom of electricity. Yet beyond his military conquests and political achievements, he still suffers headaches in the search for a queen with the opposite charge.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Extremely magnetic, quickly absorbs metal objects and turns them into explosive cherries.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits the traits of Lumos Magnet, metal object absorption CD: 0.5s.
<color=black>•</color> Can pull the pogo sticks from Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombies and convert them into Jack-in-the-Boxes; also pulls (insta-kills) Kirov Drones and converts them into Jack-in-the-Boxes.
<color=black>•</color> Deals 300 damage every 0.5s to 1 Giga Trident-nut Zombie or Giga Football-nut Zombie within range.
<color=black>•</color> Launches absorbed metal after 3s, dealing the same damage and AoE as explosive cherries; with full-map targeting and anti-air capability.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Radius ×2 | Dyson Magnet Subspecies Unlocked
2. Absorbs 3 Metal Objects at once, damage to Giga Trident-nut Zombies or Giga Football-nut Zombies ×3</color>

plants.name: Astronuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Astro-nut journeys through countless parallel worlds of the multiverse and has seen numerous wonders — from a Sphinx that plays eerie music in forgotten deserts, to a skybound ruin where a three-headed idol once stirred; from the glowing meteorites near the Tiberium shores to armored strongholds stamped with Z-Tech. He wanders through dreams, just beyond the grasp of memory. The past fades — but here, he's quite ready for another adventure.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Cosmic Wall-nut with time rewinding and extraordinary invulnerability abilities.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Quantum McCornics</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>16000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Quantum McCornics, anti-crush and takes no more than 1000 damage per hit.
<color=black>•</color> Rewinds to HP from 3s ago after taking 4000 damage and becomes invulnerable for 2s. Within 10s after a rewind, each rewind beyond the third time costs 500 HP (Rewinds within this 10s window do not reset the timer).
<color=black>•</color> 33% chance to ignore incoming damage. Has a 25% chance to teleport biters to the rightmost tile in his lane (10s cooldown).
<color=black>•</color> If HP falls below toughness, restores HP equal to 1× Robustheit after 30 consecutive seconds without taking damage.</color>

plants.name: Apocalerbsen-Kanone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>He left behind the ceaseless minigun for a railgun that fires with precise, silent power—channeling electromagnetic force sharp enough to remind some of Academy City's famed Railgun and a certain relentless shooter cloaked in black.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Consumes HP to fire pulse rays with infinite penetration.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Apeacalypse Minigun</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300×5/3s</color>
<color=black>Search Range: </color><color=#8B0000>±10° Horizontal Sector</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Apeacalypse Minigun, attacks pierce infinitely and can target air.
<color=black>•</color> If Robustheit is greater than 500, each attack consumes 100 Robustheit. Other plants cannot absorb damage for Apeacalypse Railgun.
<color=black>•</color> Attack power scales linearly as Robustheit drops, up to a max of 900.
<color=black>•</color> Click to prioritize targeting Atomheart Plantern or Magnate Plantern within ±30°. Lasers gain buffs when passing through them.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Lv1: Defense increases as HP decreases. Below 500 HP, becomes immune to damage under 1k; Lv2: Below 500 HP, base damage ×2
2. Increases projectile damage and knockback ×3</color>

plants.name: Aloe Schnee-Fichtenschütze
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At the heart of the tundra stands the Lifereaver Spruce, guardian of the frozen wilds. For years, it has endured unyielding winters, its branches heavy with frost, crowned with delicate lotus blooms. Even when playful newcomers etch runes across its bark, it remains steadfast and unshaken.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Cold gathers on spruce leaves, and lotuses bloom in the trees.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/0.02s (lasts 5s)</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains 1/1/15/60 ice charges when affected by snowball/snow trident/Ice-shroom/blizzard respectively. Passively gains 1 ice charge every 5s.
<color=black>•</color> Fires a boreal reaper saw every 1.5s that turns into a homing shot on hit, with each instance of attack applying Deep Chill, adding 1 Cryo Point, and granting 1 ice charge.
<color=black>•</color> When ice charge exceeds 50, it depletes to 0 every 5s to heal all plants in a 3×3 area for (ice charge ÷ number of plants)×(0.3×shield + 0.7×HP).
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Immun gegens Einfrieren.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Boreal reaper saws now last for 15s
2. Healing is no longer split among plants</color>

plants.name: Funkelholz des Teufels
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Infernal Sparkwood may burn brighter than any flame, but it was futuristic cuisine that truly lit up the competition. At the Culinary Clash's grand finale, he shared his trophy with Astro-nut, whose time-travel snacks left the judges starstruck. Even the judge McCornics called it "out of this world."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A Torchwood blazing with Starfruit flames, boasting extreme ignition power and granting star projectiles homing capabilities.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Infernal Squashwood</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Infernal Squashwood.
<color=black>•</color> No longer spawns Spicy Squashes. Every 51 projectiles affected spawns a Spicy Starfruit in front.
<color=black>•</color> Ignites star projectiles (except spicy stars) for ×2 damage, but with original traits removed (except Magnetar stars' aircraft downing ability), granting global homing with anti-air priority.
<color=black>•</color> Explosive cherries become Explode-o-Stars: ×2 damage, global homing with anti-air priority.
<color=black>•</color> Affects other projectiles like Infernal Squashwood. Triggers Jalapeno effect on death.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Projectiles required to spawn a Spicy plant are halved
2. Ignites the lane immediately when spawning a Spicy plant is not possible</color>

plants.name: Atompflanterne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After witnessing the how much destructive power she could bring with her nuclear detonation and the nuclear winter that followed, Atomheart Plantern decided to restrain her core reactor and applied for a quieter role as an electricity-free street light. Her constant Cherenkov glow was perfect for it. Unfortunately, zombies kept showing up, and she turned out to be very qualified for emergency use.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A Plantern sealed with radioactive frost, releasing cold fusion reactions that become stronger with Lumos.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Shroomageddon</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>600/3s</color>
<color=black>Range: </color><color=#8B0000>3×5, can target air</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks apply Deep Chill and add 30 Cryo Points.
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000> Damage increases by 100% × Lumos level.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Shroomageddon. Switching form does not trigger on-death effects.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits of Plantern.
<color=black>•</color> When targeted by an Apeacalypse Railgun, refracts the beam into three beams at 0° and ±10°: applies Chill, each hit creates a 1-tile explosion dealing 5% of the initial beam's damage
<color=black>•</color> Can store Lumos energy from Photon Splitters, up to 1000. When a Photon Splitters in a 3×3 area attacks, it consumes (1 + current energy/10) energy to enhance its laser: applies Chill, adds Cryo Points equal to energy spent, and creates a 0.74-tile explosion dealing 50% of the laser's damage.
<color=black>•</color> On death, triggers Ice-shroom effect and grants 10 Lumos levels to all plants for 10s.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Lumos addition on death ×3
2. Now immune to Cherry and Jack-in-the-Box explosions. After resisting 10k points of explosive damage, triggers a Doom-shroom explosion</color>
<color=black>Photon Splitter Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Photon Splitter and Shroomageddon's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 20k.
<color=black>•</color> Photon Splitters can send energy to Atomheart Planterns in other lanes. Lumos energy cap increases to 100k. Above 10k energy, enters Overcharge mode (attacks and gains extra Lumos energy every 0.02s). At max energy, collapses into a supermassive blackhole, rapidly pulls in and consumes non-boss zombies, then erupts in a blinding burst that deals 1M damage to all zombies 100 times.</color>

plants.name: Radiantes Seerosenblatt
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Her devotion to the Sun God flows louder than a raging river. Radiant Pad was eventually dismissed from the Sun Guard for being way too noisy—but that hasn’t stopped her from preaching His glory to every creature beneath the waves. So deep in her zeal, she hasn’t noticed one thing: she’s been blocking all the sunlight from reaching the lakebed.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Golden Lily Pad that can quickly produce copious amounts of Sun and Coins.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode with Radiant Pot</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Produces 50 Sun and 300 Coins every n=(Current Sun/1000) Seconds, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 15.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Golden Pot's Ultimate-syncing ability.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
2. Coins exceeding the maximum amount will be converted into Sun at a rate of 2:1</color>

plants.name: Tyrannofloras Lux
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tyrannoflora Lux wasn't sure how he ended up on land after a deep-sea haul, but he's made himself right at home. "Why go back to the sparse, dark depths when zombies are always on the menu?" he growls. Legend says his appetite is so huge, the gourmet contests could no longer afford their electric bill—guess he's their new emergency power source.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A giant chomper attracting zombies with light—a master of luring, devouring, and digesting.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>5 + (Sum Robustheit of Zombies)^0.33s</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000> Each Lumos level reduces digestion time by 10s to a minimum of 5s.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Anti-crush. Takes a maximum of 8k damage each hit.
<color=black>•</color> Can swallow all non-miniboss zombies in a 1.5 tile range.
<color=black>•</color> Using a Chomper seed packet on it reduces digest time by 10s.
<color=black>•</color> Upon successful digestion, pulls nearby zombies from adjacent lanes to its lane and heals to full HP.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Attack range ×2
2. Provides 2 Lumos levels to a 5×5 area during digestion</color>

plants.name: Schleuderpult
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Big brother, big sister, am I not cute?" Litter-pult winks at every passerby. "Buy a garlic, please." He works hard at his sales pitch. Why would such a small child be out selling garlic? "Grandpa's movies are too boring, and our house is so full of garlic we can't even store it anymore," he explains.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs mini garlics, which split on impact, with a chance for rapid-fire or spread-fire.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Wither-pult</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Inherits rapid-fire and spread-fire chances from Wither-pult.
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles no longer do splash damage, and each splits into a mini-garlic-cabbage, a mini-garlic-kernel (1/4 chance for mini-garlic-butter) and a garlic-melon slice.
<color=black>•</color> These projectiles behave like their non-garlic mini counterparts (See Baby Corn, Slice-pult and Sprout-pult) and each grants 1 Poison point, boosting damage by (5×Poison points).</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Spread-fire is now guaranteed
2. Lv1: Stacking Poison points will immediately poison the zombie and Poison Value Cap → 120; Lv2: Poison Value Cap removed</color>
<color=black>SP Gatling Icicle-shroom Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Gatling Icicle-shroom and Wither-pult's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> When Litter-pult and SP Gatling Icicle-shroom are planted on the same tile, the former's projectiles split one extra time, apply Chill, and inflict 5 Cryo points; while the latter's projectiles apply Toxic Effect; gain mini-garlic-butter properties.</color>

plants.name: Vulkanone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Born from the fire that forged the stars, Vulcannon burns as creation once did — not to spread without end, but to end all things. When his final blaze fades, only the silence after the first spark will remain.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Launches cobs of pure lava and heat.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>3600 (3×3)/36s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Infuses all plants in the blast area (3×3) with Cherry Bomb (prioritized)/Jalapeno (except Pumpkins and Flower Pots).
<color=black>•</color> Blasts inflict Enflamed Debuff and then does damage.
<color=black>•</color> Blasts split into multiple volcanic bombs on impact, the number increases with more zombies hit (at least 6). Volcanic bombs deal splash damage at half the power of the main blast.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Volcanic Bombs Damage ×3
2. Now triggers Thermonuclear Detonations when main blasts strike Cherry Bombs or Jalapenos (Cherry Bomb: Releases 10 Cherry Bomb effects in the surrounding area; Jalapeno: Releases 10 Jalapeno effects across the entire field. Each deals damage equal to (blast damage × 18))</color>

<color=black>SP Twin Inferno-nut Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Twin Solar-nut and Vulcannon's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 20k.
<color=black>•</color> Click on a reloaded Vulcannon while holding an SP Twin Inferno-nut with the Glove to make all reloaded Vulcannon on the field perform a synergized attack towards the sky. This shot does not cause Vulcannons to reload. Every 8th shot calls down an Inferno Meteor that repeats the following cycle 11 times: deals 80× the Vulcannon's blast damage and applies Enflamed to all zombies on screen, and triggers a Jalapeno effect with the same damage on all lanes.</color>

plants.name: Prinzessin Solarnova
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solarnova is princess of the Solaria Kingdom and a world-famous pop idol. Her hit single Dance of the Blazing Sun is so popular that even Dr. Edgar is rumored to own a copy. Despite her fame, she's approachable and loves meeting her subjects and fans, but just don't get too close, or her warmth might burn you.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Generates sun at extreme speed while melting down nearby projectiles. When active (eyes open), she unleashes searing solar flares; when inactive (winking), she stores radiant energy to be released later.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>50/3s</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Generates Sun and consumes nearby plant projectiles to absorb energy (1 damage = 1 energy). Energy is capped at Attack damage ×4; excess energy is converted to Sun (1 projectile = 5 Sun).
<color=black>•</color> When energy exceeds Attack damage, fires a solar shot that explodes on impact, dealing 100% Damage in a small area.
<color=black>•</color> Using a Coffee Bean toggles active/inactive modes. Does not attack in inactive mode.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. When a solar shot hits a zombie, it causes nearby projectiles to explode as well, dealing 10% attack damage
2. Energy cap ×3, Sun storage amount ×3</color>

plants.name: Selene-Kohl
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>She is the Moon Goddess, embodiment of calm and healing. Wherever her light falls, wounds quietly mend and all things are bathed in gentle restoration. Hanging high above the night sky, she balances yin and yang with tidal power, granting endless vitality.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Periodically summons mini-Moons to heal the battlefield. By the light of the Moon.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable with Helios Cabbage</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300×5/1.5s</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles +100 Damage per Lumos Level (bonus damage up to +500).</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Helios Cabbage.
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Mini Moon every 30s. The Mini Moon lasts for 15s and heals all plants for 50×(number of Selene Cabbages on the lawn) HP per second. This effect is tripled on the plant with the lowest HP percentage.
<color=black>•</color> If a Mini Sun is also present, healing effects are doubled.
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Damage increased by 3× per Lumos Level
2. Mini Moon heals 3×</color>
<color=black>Magnetar Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Magnetar and Helios Cabbage's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> With at least 10 Magnetars and 10 Selene Cabbages on the field, the Mini Moon from Selene Cabbage no longer disappears. Each Magnetar and Selene Cabbage channels a beam into the Mini Moon, which merges them into a single concentrated beam.
<color=black>•</color> Beam Damage: 100 × (channeling plants) every 0.02s, always locking onto the zombie with the highest max HP. Damage scales linearly over time when focusing a single target up to 5×.</color>

plants.name: Richter des Bösen
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Grim Arbiter stands as judge at the end of all things. In his jaws every offering is measured: the unworthy are stripped away, the pure are given new form, and the balance is upheld without mercy; from his maw comes a verdict no soul can escape.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Click to channel destruction into rebirth for the plants ahead, while turning curses back upon their casters.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800×2/30s (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not target zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Manual activation. Triggers a Jalapeno blast and a craterless Doom explosion in the tile directly ahead.
<color=black>•</color> If there is a plant (excluding pots and drones) in the tile in front, it is destroyed with a 50% chance to drop its seed packet. If the plant is cursed, the drop is guaranteed and the curse caster loses 15% max HP.
<color=black>•</color> Also spawns a Zombie Soul of the zombie with the highest HP on the tile in front.
<color=black>•</color>Robustheit equals the original zombie. Disappears after 10s. All final damage it receives is transferred to and split among the zombies of the same type. Transfer to mini-boss zombies is halved.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Seed packet drop is now guaranteed
2. Zombie Soul damage transfer ×2 | Wicked Undertater Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Wintermelonokopter
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Maelonstrom is obsessed with recreating cosmic nebulae in the garden. So if you ever see one forming out there, run. That's not a nebula, it's a massive cumulonimbus of melons waiting to fall.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Rapidly hurls cryo-melons through temporal vortices, and when charged, can summon a nebula rift that rains down countless more.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/0.35s (no falloff splash damage)</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks apply Chill, add 20 Cryo Points and deal 4× damage to frozen zombies.
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> No longer a catapult plant.
<color=black>•</color> Each direct base attack hit grants 1 energy stack.
<color=black>•</color> When energy meter exceeds 50, manually click to consume 30 energy and summon a nebula rift; if energy meter exceeds 100, the nebula rift doubles its projectile output.
<color=black>•</color> There can only be 1 nebula rift active at once. Each lasts 10s, drifting across the screen from left to right and raining down hail-melons.
<color=black>•</color> If the cryo-melon hits a zombie already in chronoshift, applies chronoshift to up to 2 other zombies in the splash area (3 if buffed by Melon Pot), prioritizing non-chronoshifted targets.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. For the first 5s, the nebula rift focuses on the zombie with the lowest HP, narrowing its attack range to 3 columns around the target
2. Lobbed Cryo-melons Damage ×6, but Splash Radius -50%; Zombies immune to Chronoshift will still take damage equal to (Elapsed Time)% of their HP</color>
<color=black>Quantum McCornics Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Quantum McCornics and Maelonstrom's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> Hail melons from Maelonstrom's Nebula Rifts now deal 6× damage and create Singularities, and Quantum McCornics always lob Ultimate Black Holes.
<color=black>•</color> Singularity: Lasts for 3.5s and deals 1800 Cremator damage in a 1.5-tile radius when it collapses.
<color=black>•</color> When an Ultimate Black Hole collapses, it also detonates all Singularities to further increase its own damage.</color>

plants.name: Löwenschwanz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The river is her carefully arranged stage, each ripple a string on her instrument. When zombies wade into the water, Prometheus Liontail begins her performance, fireballs as prelude, heatbeams as climax, and ashes as the finale, composing a requiem for her foes.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Holds the power of the everlasting fire, the kindler of fireballs and heatbeams that blast zombies into ash.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable (River Route)</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300×2/0.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks home in on targets across the screen and prioritize flying zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed and then cause single-target knockback and explosive cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> Gains 1 energy stack per round of attack. Gains 60 HP and 60 energy stacks when affected by Jalapeno or Cherry Bomb.
<color=black>•</color> At 240 energy, consumes all energy to fire piercing heatbeams at ±15° that deal damage every 0.15s, each hit applying the same effects as her homing shots but with 6× damage and half knockback. Lasts 3s; cannot gain energy during this time.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Heatbeam damage frequency ×2
2. Regular shots' damage ×3</color>

plants.name: Bumm-Bumm-Kirsche
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The quarrel between two hot-tempered cherries finally ended with theoretical advancements. The brothers agreed that "annihilation" was the most fitting term. "What an explosive annihilation…" "No, it's not supposed to be an explosion but an expansion!" Oh well, the argument started again.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Unleashes a massive big bang, spawning debris that deal piercing damage and leaving behind nuclear radiation.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>3600 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Explodes into 36 Cosmic Debris of equal damage and creates a Particle Soup of the same size as a Doom-shroom explosion.
<color=black>•</color> Only one Particle Soup can exist at a time. Lasts 7s, dealing (attack × remaining duration) damage every 0.5s; damage ×3 against unarmored zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Cosmic Debris pierce twice. On hit, cause Doom-shroom explosion (no crater) and Cherry Bomb explosion of equal damage.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Particle Soup initial duration increased from 7s to 10s
2. Doom Peas, Explosive Cherries, Explosive Squashes, Explosive Stars, or Ultimate Doom Shells have a 1% chance of transforming into Cosmic Debris when they hit zombies | Big Crunch Squash Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Leviathanpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>It rises from the bottomless abyss, bringing tides to the surface. Its followers span sky, land, and sea. Plants praise it as the battlefield’s ruler; zombies forewarn it will drag the world into darkness. Its own thoughts, however, remain unknown.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A resilient ocean overlord whose summoned minions drag zombies into the deep.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable (River Route)</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Anti-crush, received damage is capped at 200.
<color=black>•</color> Gains 1 energy stack per projectile hit. Gains 5 when fed a Sea-shroom.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes 1 energy when damaged, reducing that damage to 1.
<color=black>•</color> Every 15s, knocks back nearby zombies and inflicts 1 Tangle point.
<color=black>•</color> Every 15s, summons 1 Tangler minion that grabs zombies and instantly drowns them; against mini-bosses, deals (5% of their max HP * remaining grabs) as damage.
<color=black>•</color> Changes form when certain seed packets are used on it, restoring 1k HP and gaining 5 energy stacks; after 2s, summons the corresponding minions: 
<color=#0077b6>	- Ice-shroom Form:</color> Base damage cap is now 20. Every base attack/every time it's affected by an Ice-shroom, grants a Shield worth of 300 HP to all other plants in its lane.
<color=black>	- Doom-shroom Form:</color> Single-use. Summons a Doom Tangler that strikes the highest-HP zombie for damage equal to 50% of its max HP, then triggers a craterless Doom-shroom explosion.
<color=#ff10f0>	- Hypno-shroom Form:</color> Hypnotized zombies on the field now absorb damage for it. Summons Hypno Tanglers that only target Hypnotized zombies, drowning them and transforming them into Hypnotized Bombelugas.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Tangler minions can grab and drown up to 3 zombies (or deal ×3 damage) and reward 10 energy stacks for each zombie drowned
2. Fires 3 base attack projectiles at once</color>

plants.name: Metallblitzrad
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After installing the latest magnetic suspension devices, the Buck-strike Squadron finally became a precision strike team. Due to technical limitations, they can no longer use heavy weapons and must rely on machine guns, but their resolve to hit zombies with speed and freedom remains unchanged.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A highly mobile Buck-shroom unit, ready to follow orders and strike across the field.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Buck-shroom Squad's Modifier</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>6000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80 (240 after unlock condition Modifier)×3/0.16s</color><color=#8B0000></color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Buck-shroom Squad.
<color=black>•</color> Clicking the Blover Controller allows deployment of a Buck-strike unit in any chosen tile to its left. Hold Ctrl to deploy all units simultaneously.
<color=black>•</color> When there are zombies in the chosen tile or its adjacent tiles, the Buck-strike unit fires small Iron Peas, causing knockback and additional damage equal to the target's Type 2 armor HP.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Attack damage ×3
2. Attack damage ×3 | Buck-strike Squadron Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Phönix-Drohne
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's time to live up to my name," said the Phoenix Drone. For years he was trapped on the ground, but now he can finally soar like a true phoenix. Though slightly frustrated that the Cherrybomber Drone beat him to it, conquering the skies is still a joy.

-Written by Medineer Gaming</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Spreads wings like a phoenix and rides the wind.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Phoenix Threepeater's Modifier</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>160×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Phoenix Threepeater.
<color=black>•</color> Flying plant. Projectiles inflict the Enflamed debuff and pierce 2 times.
<color=black>•</color> On death, triggers Jalapeno effect in the same lane and 2 adjacent lanes.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Enflamed damage bonus 50% → 150%, and regular ignited projectiles can now inflict the debuff
2. Phoenix peas can now pierce infinitely and cause Enflamed explosions | Phoenix Drone Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: SP-Doppelsolar-Nuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>To push photosynthesis research even further, SP Twin Solar-nut began a deeper study of chloroplasts. "Clearly, chloroplasts do far more than most plants imagine," says SP Twin Solar-nut. "They not only increase photosynthetic efficiency, but also promote the growth and mitosis of bowling balls."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Stores energy from Sun, using heavier Nuts to drop massive amounts of sun and snowball the profit.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Auto-Unlocked After Obtaining Twin Solar-nut's 2 Modifiers</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Promotion of Twin Solar-nut, inherits its other traits.
<color=black>•</color> Tapping on it:
- Spends 500 Sun.
- Restores his Robustheit to full.
- Gains 10 Solar charges.
- Summons 2 Bowling Solar-nuts that roll at ±45° angles forward and ricochet on hit. These each deal a one-time damage equal to the summoner's HP and drop 5 sun n times, where n equals the number of hits so far.
- Summons a Giant Solar-nut 1 tile ahead.
- Improves an existing Giant Solar-nut by enlarging its size, knockback and damage (higher base damage yields less bonus, down to 60%).
- After not tapping for 1s, the existing Giant Solar-nut will roll forward, crushing and knocking back zombies. Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively. Also drops 15 Sun each time it hits a new zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Gains 1 Solar charge every time your Sun increases.
<color=black>•</color> When Solar charge meter reaches 100, automatically consumes 100 Solar charges to summon a Giant Solar-nut improved 5 times.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Click Cost 500 → 200 Sun | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Twin Solar-nut: Robustheit reduces by 10 for each hit instead of 50 | Twin Inferno-nut Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants</color>

plants.name: Pandämonium-Haubitze
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Panmelonium represents the peak of cold ordnance design: distributed warheads, guided escorts, and relentless frostfire. He advances without haste, ending battles not with fury, but with absolute zero.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Launches bone-chilling clusterbombs for saturated bombardment.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Cob-literator</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator) ×40</color>
<color=black>Reloading Time: </color><color=#8B0000>36s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Cob-literator.
<color=black>•</color> Conversions between Panmelonium and Cob-literator reset remaining reloading time of both to 36s.
<color=black>•</color> Manually click to fire 4 Oblivion Clusterbombs which spawn 36 additional Minishells. Minishells prioritize targeting zombies on the field, with a higher chance to strike zombies near the aimed position.
<color=black>•</color> Oblivion Clusterbombs damage the full-screen; Minishells' splash radius is 1.5 tiles. On hit, both apply Freeze for 5s before dealing damage, and permanently reduce zombie speed by 0.005×, up to a maximum reduction to 0.9×.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Damage ×4
2. Reload Time → 12s</color>

plants.name: Crunchkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Big Crunch Squash always glares straight ahead with a scowl, wearing the same bad temper even while eating or sleeping. Though this makes his allies uneasy, compared to those two noisy brothers, he is actually quite friendly.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Holds the immense power of universe-contraction, but while on standby, its potential gradually decays to zero.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Big Bang Cherry's Modifier</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>3600 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Big Bang Cherry.
<color=black>•</color> On landing, triggers a Doom-shroom blast with 3600 damage, with the crater remaining at the jump-off position, releases a ring of 36 pieces of Cosmic Debris each dealing the same damage and creates a Particle Soup lasting [7 - 0.25 × (Big Crunch Squash's time on the lawn)] seconds, down to 0s.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Particle Soup initial duration increased from 7s to 10s
2. Doom Peas, Explosive Cherries, Explosive Squashes, Explosive Stars, or Ultimate Doom Shells have a 1% chance of transforming into Cosmic Debris when they hit zombies | Big Crunch Squash Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Eruptionsgeschütz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Kaledera Eruptor is a cosmologist. Unlike his colleagues, he believes the universe is not a fire that burns out and collapses, but a continuously active existence. To prove this theory, he created high-heat cabbages that can be preserved long-term on Umbrella Kales as a model. The model failed to convince his peers, but achieved unexpected success on the battlefield against zombies.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs cabbages for explosive and incendiary damage.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Vulcannon</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300×n/0.75s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Vulcannon.
<color=black>•</color> Conversion to Vulcannon resets remaining reloading time to 36s.
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, lobs one Pyro Cabbage at each zombie (up to 10) in the forward area of his lane and the 2 adjacent lanes.
<color=black>•</color> Pyro Cabbages apply Enflamed on hit, then trigger an explosion with a 1-tile radius, identical to that of Explosive Cherries.
<color=black>•</color> Umbrella Kale or Midas Umbrella in front in of his lane can also intercept Pyro Cabbages that would have been thrown to adjacent lanes and boost them.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Pyro Cabbages Damage ×3
2. Attacks have a 10% chance to trigger Cherry Bomb and Jalapeno effects at the barrel position and ignore the target limit of 10</color>

plants.name: Charmetronkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As zombie numbers continued to rise, how to stay popular among zombies became a hot topic. "Relying on traditional communication alone is no longer enough," says Pumpkaptivator. "I will use a brand-new radio-wave microphone to deliver my music and feelings to a wider audience of zombies." With this move, she ushered in a new trend in zombie culture.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Charisma aeterna.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Charmatron</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Charmatron.
<color=black>•</color> Zombies that try to bite it are hypnotized instead.
<color=black>•</color> Captures 1 non-flying, non-miniboss hypnotized zombie that passes through, preventing it from leaving the tile and having it absorb damage for the Pumpkaptivator.
<color=black>•</color> Deals damage equal to 0.1× max HP per second to the captured hypnotized zombie and gains 4 energy stacks.
<color=black>•</color> When energy stack is ≥0/50/100, Charge Level is at 1/2/3, draining 1/2/2 energy per second respectively. Charge Level 3 is locked behind a Modifier.
<color=black>•</color> At charge levels 1/2/3, every 15/10/6s, hypnotizes 1 non-flying, non-miniboss zombie within a 1.5-tile radius. On success, the plant inside the shell gains a damage boost of (60% × Charge Level) for 1s. Every time a Pumpkaptivator activates this effect, Laser Pumpkins and Blast Pumpkins in the same Magnetic system resonate and trigger the same effect simultaneously.
<color=black>•</color> While a Charmatron is inside, the Charmatron always benefits from the same damage boost of (60% × Charge Level).</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Damage to captured hypnotized Zombies halved</color>
<color=#8B0000>2. Charge Level 3 unlocked</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>Conversion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Shovel <-> Glove the Charmatron onto a Pumpkin</color>

plants.name: Doppel-Infernuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Heliology is dead!" cries Twin Inferno-nut, so enraged that he nearly overturns his own laboratory. "They were all lying to me, Sunflower, Sun-shroom, even Endoflame." Helios Cabbage considers stepping in to ask what happened, but seeing the lab in ruins and countless bowling nuts rolling across the floor, decides it is better to wait until Twin Inferno-nut cools off.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>On taking damage, consumes Sun to gain HP. Spends HP to create Giant Inferno-nuts that can tear through Enflamed zombies.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Twin Solar-nut's Modifier</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Twin Solar-nut.
<color=black>•</color> HP can exceed Robustheit with no upper limit. Excess HP decays at a rate of (10% of Total HP per second).
<color=black>•</color> When taking non-crushing damage, can consume 15 Sun to negate the damage and gain 50 HP.
<color=black>•</color> Reflects 20 damage when bitten and applies Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Gains 3000 HP when affected by Jalapeno (including initially).
<color=black>•</color> Click to spend 500 health to spawn 1 Giant Inferno-nut in the tile in front. It begins rolling 1s after the last click. Before it rolls off, further clicks increase the existing Giant Inferno-nut's size and damage. Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively. The Giant Inferno-nut does ×2 to Enflamed zombies.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Healing amount ×2 | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Twin Inferno-nut: Click cost 500 → 200 HP | Twin Inferno-nut Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants</color>

plants.name: SP Doppel-Infernuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Light energy, thermal energy, kinetic energy, mass… all of it is transforming within me." SP Twin Inferno-nut is driven by grand ambition, forging a path never walked before - unifying all forms of energy into one. For this great mission, he is willing to give up everything, even the annual summer beach ice-cream gathering.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Stores energy drawn from fire and flesh, using even stronger Nuts to send zombies "rolling away."

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Auto-Unlocked After Obtaining Twin Solar-nut's 2 Modifiers</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Promotion of Twin Inferno-nut, inherits its other traits; Subspecies of SP Twin Solar-nut.
<color=black>•</color> HP can exceed Robustheit with no upper limit. Excess HP decays at a rate of (10% of Total HP per 3s).
<color=black>•</color> When taking non-crushing damage, can consume 15 Sun to negate the damage and gain 50 HP and 2 Infernal charges.
<color=black>•</color> Also gains 10 Infernal charges when affected by Jalapeno (including initially).
<color=black>•</color> Click to spend 500 health to gain 10 Infernal charges and spawn 1 Giant Inferno-nut in the tile in front. It begins rolling 1s after the last click. Before it rolls off, further clicks increase the existing Giant Inferno-nut's size, damage and knockback. Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively. The Giant Inferno-nut does ×2 to Enflamed zombies.
<color=black>•</color> When Infernal charge meter reaches 100, automatically consumes 100 Infernal charge to summon a Giant Inferno-nut improved 5 times.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Healing amount ×2 | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Twin Inferno-nut: Click cost 500 → 200 HP | Twin Inferno-nut Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants</color>

<color=black>Vulcannon Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Twin Solar-nut and Vulcannon's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 20k.
<color=black>•</color> Click on a reloaded Vulcannon while holding an SP Twin Inferno-nut with the Glove to make all reloaded Vulcannon on the field perform a synergized attack towards the sky. This shot does not cause Vulcannons to reload. Every 8th shot calls down an Inferno Meteor that repeats the following cycle 11 times: deals 80× the Vulcannon's blast damage and applies Enflamed to all zombies on screen, and triggers a Jalapeno effect with the same damage on all lanes.</color>
plants.cost:
<size=36>Conversion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Sunflower <-> Jalapeno</color>
Promotion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Wall-nut + Twin Inferno-nut</color>

plants.name: Maisband
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cornveyor Weed works at a large butter-processing factory, where the heavy, monotonous labor leaves him so exhausted that he sticks out his tongue every day. After work, all he wants is to lie down at home and rest, but zombies keep coming like flies, forcing him back into battle. Unfortunately, the fighting is just as dull as his day job: a never-ending butter conveyor line.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A sticky, slippery "road of Zomzomphus."

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Ignored by vehicles and immune to most types of damage; takes 10 damage when smashed by Gargantuars.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks knock back but no longer pops tires.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3 total hits, applies 1 second of Butter stun to one zombie.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Cornveyor Weed's Butter stun duration ×3 | Cornposter Pot Subspecies Unlocked
2. Now makes zombies on it to continuously slide to the right</color>

plants.name: SP MG-Unheil
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silence. Deep, cold silence. The ashes of what was once thriving crackle faintly. Nothing remains; only lifeless cinders as far as the eye can see. A light breeze brushes across the barren field. This land is scorched now. This is the end.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires Irradiated Shells that inflict extra effects based on status debuffs.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Auto-Unlocked After Obtaining Doom Gatling's 2 Modifiers</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Promotion of Doom Gatling, inherits its other traits.
<color=black>•</color> Fires Irradiated Shells that ignore Type 2 armor in rounds of 4 and applies Irradiated debuff. Fires an Ultimate Irradiated Shell that deals 1800 damage once every 4 rounds of bullets and then rests for 4.5s after the Ultimate Irradiated Shell is shot. Ultimate Irradiated Shells deal splash damage over a large area twice.
<color=black>•</color> Depending on the target's debuffs, gains the following effects:
- Chilled: Freezes the target for 1s and multiplies the damage of this hit by 4.
- Enflamed: Triggers an Enflamed explosion dealing the same damage as this hit.
 - Poisoned: Deals extra damage equal to (hit damage × 0.5 × [Poison value]).
<color=black>•</color> Only Ultimate Irradiated Shell's second explosion triggers the effects above. See Doomwood's entry for extra interactions between Irradiated and other debuffs.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. No more rest after firing an Ultimate Doom Shell | Gatling Frenzy-shroom Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Now fires an Ultimate Doom Shell every round instead of every 4th round | Effects also apply to SP variants</color>

plants.name: SP MG-Rasereipilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>SP Gatling Frenzy-shroom has been growing her hair out for a while now. A lot of people ask how the crack in her helmet got there. She always answers, "Oh, that was on purpose. It lets my hair show."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires special Irradiated Shells that enhance Irradiated's combo with other status debuffs.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Auto-Unlocked After Obtaining Doom Gatling's 2 Modifiers</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/1.5s (0.25 Minimum)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Promotion of Gatling Frenzy-shroom, inherits its other traits; Subspecies of SP Gatling Doom.
<color=black>•</color> Fires Irradiated Shells. Fires an Ultimate Irradiated Shell every 16 attacks, dealing 1800 damage, and then rests for 4.5s.
<color=black>•</color> When frightened, resets attack speed and triggers a craterless Doom-shroom effect (does not self-destruct).
<color=black>•</color> Depending on the target's debuffs, gains the following effects:
- Chilled: Chilled duration increased by 25%.
- Enflamed: Damage bonus increased by an additive 40%, stackable with other increases.
- Poisoned: Poison points now stack twice.</color>
<color=black>Main Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. No more rest after firing an Ultimate Doom Shell | Gatling Frenzy-shroom Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Now fires an Ultimate Doom Shell every 4 attacks | Effects also apply to SP variants</color>

<color=black>Cherrybomber Drone Synergy Modifier:</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> You must have unlocked all Gatling Cherrybomber and Gatling Doom's modifiers before this synergy becomes available in the shop for 15k.
<color=black>•</color> When Cherrybomber Drone and SP Gatling Frenzy-shroom are on the same tile, they perform coordinated attacks, and the former gains 0.05 energy while the latter gains 0.1 energy. Energy drains at 0.3 per second. For the first 7 whole points of energy, each increases the number of shots fired during coordinated attacks by 1. Energy above 7 increases the 8th bullet’s damage by ×(1 + excess point).</color>
plants.cost:
<size=36>Conversion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Peashooter <-> Scaredy-shroom</color>
Promotion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Doom-shroom > Gatling Frenzy-shroom</color>

plants.name: Sturmhäschen
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"We're a band of wizards from the Frost Magic Tower. Just look at these fluffy scarves. Nothing's warmer than this, not even lightning magic." Thunder Bunnyons wiggle their long bunny ears… As for why they have bunny ears at all, that question has baffled taxonomists everywhere.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Channels team power to unleash chain lightning and help Aristocattail summon drones.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Aristocattail's Modifier</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>5×5</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Aristocattail.
<color=black>•</color> Tapping a Thunder Bunnyon designates it as the Team Leader, as indicated by its lightning orb sparkling. Only one Leader can exist at a time; all others become Members.
<color=black>• Team Leader:</color> Strikes zombies with electricity. On hit, it can arc up to 5 times to other zombies (the same zombie can become a non-consecutive target too) within a 2.2-tile radius. Arcs deal 50% the original damage. Damaged zombies have their DR value reduced by 3 (mini-bosses by 1), down to 0.
<color=black>• Members:</color> Do not attack. Each Member increases the Leader's attack damage by 1.5× and increases the number of arcs by 3.
<color=black>•</color> When the electric arc kills a zombie, a random Aristocattail on the field summons a nerfed Drone that fires only 20 straight-shot bullets, each dealing 160 damage.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Summoned Drone is no longer nerfed and fires 60 shots normally
2. Attack Damage ×3 | Thunder Bunnyon Subspecies Unlocked</color>

plants.name: Dyson-Magnet
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Dyson Magnet has spent her whole life trying to harness the power of stars themselves to help her fellow magnetic friends. Starting off small, at least in her mind, she has been successful in linking the power of the Sun to the power of any magnetic system she desires to join; effortlessly providing sustenance to her allies without expecting much in return. Her final goal is to harness the power of a galaxy, and become so efficient in transforming energy that she can unite the plants and zombies. She would also like to find a partner, possibly becoming the queen of a kingdom with a certain other plant...</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Uses the power of light and magnetism to rapidly produce Metal Objects, while granting damage bonuses and healing to magnetic plants.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable With Tesla Magnet's Modifier</color><color=black>
Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Subspecies of Tesla Magnet.
