plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Reproduction and proliferation are life's instincts. Under certain conditions, Minnow-shrooms grow together, resisting waves, and swim in schools to confuse predators. In recent years, technology enabling compact breeding has finally been developed and immediately applied in aquariums.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Highly reproductive; an important part of the ocean fungal ecosystem.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2 (later ×3)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not return Sun on fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts out as a school of 2.
<color=black>•</color> Grows into a school of 3 after 15s.
<color=black>•</color> Afterwards, feeds the plant directly in front with a Sea-shroom every 15s. If unsuccessful, drops a Sea-shroom seed packet.</color>

plants.name: Orcapilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>They say this giant used to swim in the open seas of Sharktooth Ridge, the terror of all fish. But one fateful mishap with a certain Shrink Shroom bubble somehow left him tiny. His body's shrunken, but not his appetite, nor his penchant for explosive enthusiasm when a Sea-shroom drifts too close.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>After consuming Sea-shrooms, spits small Doom-bombs forward.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>600</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Launches a Doom spore that deals 600 damage in a moderate radius after consuming a Sea-shroom. Feeding has no CD, but each shot takes 1.5s to fire and only a max of 2 shots can register at the same time.</color>

plants.name: Zundersonne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Torchflower is always cheerful, even able to smile through her doctoral dissertation. "Become the sunshine you have always been looking for." she wrote in the acknowledgments at the end of her paper.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Melts nearby projectiles into Sun!

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time she produces Sun, converts all plant (and hypnotized zombie) projectiles in a 1.5 tile radius into Sun at a rate of 5 Sun per projectile.</color>

plants.name: Hypnoqualle
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Am I a Jellyfish? Or a Mushroom? Guess wrong, and you'll have to work for me." The Jelly-shroom loves playing these games with brainless zombies and has never lost. The closest to the right answer was Professor Cherryz, who answered "I know Box Jellies are not true Jellies… Are you one of those?"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Summons grunt zombies to fight for you after consuming a Sea-shroom.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a hypnotized Ducky Tube Zombie (browncoat) that fights for you after consuming a Sea-shroom.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then disappears.</color>

plants.name: MG-Football
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Foul play! You're out!" Football Gatling is the strictest and most hot-tempered referee on the field, upholding football rules. From start to finish, his mouth never stops, constantly trying to eject players who don't understand the game.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Occasionally fires red shots that lure Football Zombies away.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>3000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80×4/2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant. Counts as an Advanced Fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Type 2 armor (before damage reduction).
<color=black>•</color> Every 12th shot is a Football Pea that causes hit Red-colored Football Zombies to run away from your house.</color>

plants.name: Sonnenstern
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm Solarfruit, not Sunny Five-fingers! Don't mix us up!" Solarfruit always tries to explain that he's different from Sunny Five-fingers, but his plant friends don't care. The only supporters he has are the zombies, since they think fingers are definitely more annoying to gnaw on than fruits.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Uses Sun to shoot high-damage stars.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100×5</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Click on a Solarfruit to spend 25 Sun and make it shoot 5 100-damage Stars in 5 directions.
<color=black>•</color> Uses Sun and shoots automatically every 0.35s if placed in a Starry Pumpkin.</color>

plants.name: Sonnenbrand
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Why do so many plants feel distant from her? She can't figure it out: "I can both defend you and bring you sunshine!" She believes she's brighter and sunnier than Jalapeno, but other plants think she's more destructive.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Burns other plants to enhance her power.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Returns 25 Sun for every zombie hit.
<color=black>•</color> Also deals 1800 damage to all plants in her lane. Each affected plant drops 50 Sun and boosts Solar Flare's damage by 500. If a plant would be destroyed, it has a 1/3 chance to survive with 1 HP remaining.</color>

plants.name: Nuss-terne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Streetlights sometimes malfunction, and that’s normal. This is when my role as a backup streetlight becomes important, though everyone seems worried about me," said Illumi-nut. He didn't know that others worry not about his brightness, but that he might break the streetlight frame.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Wall-nut with Plantern properties; heals himself with Lumos level.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Provides 1 Lumos Level in a 3×3 area. Restores 150 Robustheit per Lumos Level every 15s.</color></size>

plants.name: Angsthaselnuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sturdy-shroom was originally shy like other Scaredy-shrooms, until seeing distant relatives with "Mushroom Power" on TV — unafraid of zombies. He decided to learn from them, nicknamed himself "Mushroom Lee," and trained day and night to face zombies without fear.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Very slim defender, but will fight back when cornered.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> After cowering for 10s, immediately stands up and knocks back nearby zombies, dealing 20 damage to the zombie's body, its Type 1 armor and Type 2 armor simultaneously. For the next 5s, he will not hide himself again. While cowering, takes 50% reduced damage.</color>

plants.name: Topfnuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone speculated about Nut Pot's appearance: some said he was a broken nut, others that he was a damaged daruma doll. Whatever others guessed, Nut Pot didn't answer. Those boring past events were buried by lava. "At least now, I am a Pot," he said.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Heat-insulated defensive Flower Pot.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reduces incoming damage to the plant on top by 20%.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Lava tile damage and protects the plant on top.
<color=black>•</color> Lava tiles deal 50 damage per second to plants and zombies on them, prioritizing Flower Pots, dealing 10 damage to them instead.</color>

plants.name: Dicknuss
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Wallop-shroom trained a batch of Nut-shrooms but didn't teach them combat. When asked, "How do we defend against zombies?" he replied: "With a hard shell and do-or-die determination!" Then he launched them at the zombies. "This is a technique I learned from baseball," he announced proudly.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Picks up nearby Nut-shrooms to attack.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Picks up Nut-shrooms within a 3×3 area and bats them forward as projectiles. Projectile damage equals the Nut-shroom's HP and ignores Type 2 armor. If the projectile hits a zombie and deals enough damage to kill it, the shot pierces through, with its damage reduced by the amount dealt.</color>

plants.name: Schlingnuss
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone says Tangle-nut is very reclusive, with such tangled problems that it is difficult to unravel to reach such a hard heart. But who can deny his desire for solitude? No one, except Cattail, who sometimes mistakes him for a ball of string to play with.

-Written by Ultra Badlander</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Applies Tangle value as retaliation.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> When bitten, inflicts 1 Tangle value on the attacker. When crushed, loses 50 HP every 0.02s and inflicts 1 Tangle value each time.</color>

plants.name: Morphmelone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Melon Morph used to work at the Electromagnetics Research Institute and once proposed a conjectured model of magnetic poles, suggesting that magnetic poles are distributed like watermelon seeds embedded in a watermelon. However, his theory was ignored, because he was only the institute's watermelon supplier.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Stepping stone for other Metal Melon fusions, also deals heavy damage to helmeted zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Deals 2× damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor. Can fuse with Bucket and Chrono Core.</color>

plants.name: Metallmelone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Covering his body in iron saved the Metal-pult from ending up at the fruit stall, but he still faces many troubles, like spending heavily on rust-proofing and constantly answering other curious plants: "Are your leaves also made of iron? Can iron leaves be used as fruit knives?"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lumps heavy balls of pure iron at the zombies, dishing out heavy damage.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>200/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Deals 2× damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor.</color>

plants.name: Chronomelone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm just standing on the shoulders of giants!" Chrono Melon humbly says. "I never had the power to reverse time; I only spread temporal chaos."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Spreads Chronoshift effect via splash damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Splash damage is equal to main damage and has no falloff.
<color=black>•</color> If a zombie directly hit or in splash radius has Chronoshift effect, up to 3 splash targets (6 if buffed by Melon Pot) will also be afflicted with the effect.</color>

plants.name: Schreckens-Paprika
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm about to explode! Everyone in front of me better watch out, plant or zombie alike! This is mutual destruction, assured!" said M.A.D. Pepper. His slightly trembling body indicates a massive energy build-up, or maybe it's just from standing on tiptoes with an unstable stance.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Also burns your plants to trigger chain explosions.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not explode automatically; click manually to trigger a Jalapeno blast and a Doom-shroom explosion.
<color=black>•</color> In every other tile in the same lane that has a plant, releases a Doom-shroom explosion without leaving craters and destroys all plants in that tile; the destroyed plants have a 25% chance to drop as a Seed packet.</color>

plants.name: Kürbse
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Heard that some zombies brought a "tank"? Then show them the living machine-gun fortress — Pumpkin Pod! As for ammo… well, the designer forgot to include any! But no problem! Let the peashooters inside "share" some ammo!</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Copies the behavior of the Pea-shooting plant inside it.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>?</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>If a Pea-family plant is inside, it copies the attack of that plant, matching that plant's projectile count, damage, and type and shoots at 50% the attack rate, with a min. attack CD of 3s and a max. of 6s. These shots are considered to be fired by the internal plant.</color>

plants.name: Flammen-Erbse
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>This Peashooter loves roasted peas so much that even on the battlefield, he snacks between shots. "Ahh! My peas!" - looks like he accidentally spat out his snack again.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires Blaze Peas that inflict Enflamed.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.

plants.name: Flamminator
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Double firepower, double thrill, double fun! Compared to Blaze Pea, I like eating hotpot twice in a row!" He doesn't realize that Infernowood now has double the workload.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires Blaze Peas in pairs.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

plants.name: Knallflamme
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Damn it! Where's our support? Machine gunner on the left, move right!" Hot-tempered and easily enraged, this shooter often yells at teammates, though luckily, he hasn't started firing at them yet.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires Blaze Peas in triple bursts.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

plants.name: MG-Flamme
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tired of treating endless burn victims, this pea doctor now takes his proud invention of pyrotherapy to cure the problem at its source.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires 4 Blaze Peas at once.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.</color>

plants.name: Muffelkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After countless revisions, Stinky Pumpkin is finally combat-ready. Compared to regular Garlic, it fixes issues like weak defense, space efficiency and inability to protect plants from projectiles. As for that smell… well, time to test everyone's endurance.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Pumpkin with Garlic traits.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Zombies that bite him will be poisoned for 10s, forced to change lanes and accumulate 1 Poison point.</color>

plants.name: Sonnenkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Recently obsessed with camping, Sunny Pumpkin beams: "Camping's the best! I get to shield everyone and be their little sun!" Rain or zombies, her teammates love having her around.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Generates Sun while reinforcing plants.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000 + ?</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Gives 50 HP as Shield to all plants in her tile every time she produces Sun. The total Shield value has no upper cap.</color>

plants.name: Eiscremepilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As rare as a polar sunrise, this frosty innovator spends all his time perfecting his craft of dessert-making. His signature sundae is the Sunny Orange Delight, loved by plants and zombies alike (even if it drains the last of their warmth).</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Gradually melts, releasing cold and sunlight in stages.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> At each sun production, makes all frozen zombies drop 15 sun.
<color=black>•</color> For the first two sun production cycles, triggers Ice-shroom effects that inflict chill but don't freeze. On the third cycle, triggers full Ice-shroom effect, then disappears.</color>

plants.name: Sonnen-Hypnosepilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every year, she joins the garden darting contest - hitting zombies flying, snorkling, hypnotized, or even hypnotized with her sun-shaped darts. Despite her flawless precision, she never wins… the judges can never find her.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Produces Sun; upon being bitten, releases a Solar Comet that ricochets among zombies.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and summons a Solar Comet.
<color=black>•</color> The Solar Comet seeks out zombies (prioritizing hypnotized ones) and bounces between them, up to 10 times. When it hits a hypnotized zombie, it deals 200 damage and drops 25 Sun. When it hits a non-hypnotized zombie, it deals 100 damage and drops 15 Sun.
<color=black>•</color> After the Comet completes its bounces or disappears, it drops an additional 25 Sun.</color>

plants.name: Schnabulürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Chompkin opened a gym for Chompers, meant to help them digest better, burn fat, and stay in shape. It became wildly popular, but he's not happy. "They're not training, they're eating! My gym’s become a buffet!" he vents.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Provides digestive aids for Chomper-type plants inside his shell to speed up digestion.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Periodically uses a reserve Digestive Sac to help the Chomper plant in the same tile to instantly finish digesting (or to instantly recharge the Devour abilities of Chompzillas and its fusions).
<color=black>•</color> Generates 1 Digestive Sac every 40s, up to a maximum of 3 at the same time. First Digestive Sac takes 7.5s to generate.</color>

plants.name: Tripli-Stinker
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"Ugh, your taste stinks! I hate you two!" cries the third head. Zombies think he's crying from his fellows' smell, but actually, it's just because of their terrible taste in music. "We don't even have noses," the first head explains.

-Written by silver fool</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Shoots Poison peas; makes poisoned zombies release toxic clouds on hit.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20× the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>

plants.name: Krankheits-Sniperbse
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>She doesn't actually carry viruses, but everyone avoids her - that strong garlic smell is enough. "The smell actually prevents viruses," she insists. The zombies don't buy it.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Snipes targets to spread an Infectious Cloud that multiplies like a virus.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>500/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Creates an Infectious Cloud at the target's location. Headshots create a Virulent Cloud instead.</color>
<color=#5E1675>Infectious Clouds: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Moves randomly across the lawn.
<color=black>•</color> Lasts 15s. Every second, inflicts Garlic Butter and 1 Garlic Point to zombies inside (Virulent Clouds have doubled radius and tick rate).
<color=black>•</color> When inflicting Garlic Points, deal (20×Garlic Points) damage. If the target is immune to poison, deals 300 damage instead.
<color=black>•</color> Targets that have lost their heads (HP below threshold) die instantly, spawning a new Infectious Cloud at their position.
<color=black>•</color> If 30 Infectious Clouds already exist, new ones won't spawn and instead expand the nearest Cloud's radius and increase its damage by 10%.</color>

plants.name: Tripli-Bomber
plants.introduce: "Delicious cherries!" "Fresh cherries!" "Cheap cherries!" Cherry-spreader's three mouths shout tirelessly, yet their cherry business never seems to take off. Those who have tried them say these cherries are just too sticky.
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires half-ripe cherries across three lanes. They stick to zombies and mature after a short delay, then explode.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles attach to targets and explode after 6s with a 1-tile splash radius. Each zombie can only have one half-ripe cherry attached.
<color=black>•</color> While attached, half-ripe cherries absorb 25% of all cherry-type projectile and cherry explosion damage the zombie takes, adding that to its final explosion damage.</color>

plants.name: Kommander Dynamit
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At the 5th Annual Garden Quickdraw Championship, Dynamite Commando shared his secret to victory: "I use specially crafted cherry rounds. Their small size means I can store plenty, and the stickiness helps them cluster together for rapid bursts. Of course, keeping the barrel well-lubricated is absolutely essential."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Shoots half-ripe cherries at zombies, with a small chance of shooting a massive barrage!

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×6/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/0.02s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>2% chance to shoot a barrage of half-ripe cherries each attack, lasting 5s. These explode instantly and attach a half-ripe cherry to all zombies in the damage radius.</color>

plants.name: Teufelskirsche
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You can't host a party in the garden without a permit." Black Cherry casually tells the unregistered zombies off. "The first time's just a warning. If they still don't leave after that, I'll take action. Well, some can't even handle the warning."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Unleashes a Cherry Bomb blast, then uses the resulting ash to trigger an even stronger Doom-shroom explosion.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion on fusion, and explodes like a Doom-shroom after 1.5s.
<color=black>•</color> The Doom-shroom blast deals 1800 base Cremator damage, increasing by a factor of (# of zombies hit by the initial Cherry bomb explosion) × 1/6. (For reference, if one zombie is hit by the initial cherry explosion, the cremator damage will be 7/6 times the original damage).</color>

plants.name: Hypnobombe
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Catalyst-shroom was nearly expelled from the Zombuddies Club. The zombies she hypnotized always turned furious and destructive, which the club considered contrary to its peaceful values. She defended herself with a single sentence: "I'm merely helping my zombie friends vent their frustration toward Dr. Edgar."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>The catalyst for making zombies more explosive.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon being bitten, turns the zombie into a Hypnotized Explode-o-shooter Zombie and disappears.</color>

plants.name: Meereskürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once a star performer at the World Marine Life Festival and the pride of the Sea-shroom colony, Sea-shell can no longer float on water. Everything changed after that dreadful Halloween party. He wore a pumpkin head for the perfect performance, only to find he could never take it off again.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Regenerates itself using Sea-shroom seed packets.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Land plant. Can be fed Sea-shroom seed packets to heal by 1/3 max HP.</color>

plants.name: Hypnomaul
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Chomper looks down on his fellow Chompers. He thinks they're rude, picky eaters, and lazy freeloaders who produce nothing for the garden, unlike him, with his dazzling, radiant skin.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Devours hypnotized zombies and converts them into Hypno-shrooms.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Also targets Hypnotized zombies and drops a Hypno-shroom seed packet on a successful devour of a Hypnotized zombie, then digests for 10s.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then reverts to a Chomper.</color>

plants.name: Jalahypño
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm actually very harmless," said Hypno Pepper, adjusting his hat. "I help zombies find their hidden fragility, guiding them to drop their pretense and become open, honest friends." As for the blazing flames? "That's just the hypnotium doing its magic. It doesn't really hurt the fragile zombies."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Explodes with fiery charm, causing zombies to switch sides.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Hypnotizes all zombies with less than 900 HP in its lane. Deals 1800 Cremator damage to all other zombies in its lane.</color>

plants.name: Butterkraut
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike other Spikeweeds, Butterweed is exceptionally gentle. It has no sharp spikes, dislikes violent sports, and just wants zombies to try a slice of its homemade butter cake. Unfortunately, with his poor eyesight, he always offers the butter to the wrong spot.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Sticky, buttery slow trap that doesn't deal damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>0</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Slows down all non-flying zombies that walk over it and Butters them for 1s every 3s.
<color=black>•</color> No longer pops tires and is ignored by vehicles.</color>

plants.name: Kalterne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Winter is the season for meditation. The cold sharpens the mind. With gnawing winds and silent nights, such a perfect time for reflection should not be wasted. For days on end, the night-watching Aurora Plantern has been pondering what he should be thinking about. Oh wait, that's it! Thinking about what to think about!</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Freezes zombies with a cold aura and enables lasers to gain chilling effects.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Plantern traits.
<color=black>•</color> Once per second, deals 20 damage and applies Chill to zombies in within a 1.1-tile radius, and prolongs the Freeze duration of the zombies already frozen by 1s (cannot be reapplied to the same zombie).
<color=black>•</color> Anti-ground Lasers from Lumos Cactus/Ray-shroom turn cyan and gain the ability to apply Chill after passing through.</color>

plants.name: Landmine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After lying in wait for a long time, Land-mine has drawn sufficient strength from sunlight and moisture, gaining power comparable to a Cherry Bomb. "Spudow!" he shouted, but the zombies were only surprised.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Can grow twice.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Initial)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts in an armed state. Grows 30s after appearance, doubling its damage.
<color=black>•</color> After another 30s, grows again and increases explosion radius to 1.5 tiles across lanes.</color>

plants.name: Sea-mine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The moment he enters the pool, Sea-mine absorbs water like a little water baby, convinced this will greatly amplify his explosive power. While this does turn out to be true, he still cannot understand how it all works, just as he cannot understand why the pool is never completely filled with dead zombies either.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Aquatic and can grow twice.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Initial)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts in an armed state. Grows 30s after appearance, doubling its damage.
<color=black>•</color> After another 30s, grows again and increases explosion radius to 1.5 tiles across lanes.</color>

plants.name: Schwarzlicht-Pflanterne
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Blacklight Plantern doesn't consume darkness to create light. Their light is fueled by their contempt for the Zombies, and a couple grams of plutonium. "My light burns with rage. Pray you don't find it pointed at you."

-Written by Goober</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>His UV light is radioactive and grants lasers explosive effects.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Plantern traits.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3s, supplies Doomwoods in a 3×3 area with 3 Irradiation value.
<color=black>•</color> Anti-ground Lasers from Lumos Cactus/Ray-shroom turn purple and gain the ability to trigger a 1-tile explosion dealing 10 damage on hit after passing through.</color>

plants.name: Kohlkanone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>With a thunderous boom, bright-green shells soar into the sky. "A farewell gift," says Cab-barrage with a nod. "May their last meal be filling, even if it is not brains. Everyone gets a serving."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Bombards a wide area ahead with cabbages.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/0.75s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, lobs one cabbage at each zombie in the forward area of his lane and the 2 adjacent lanes.
<color=black>•</color> Umbrella Kale or Midas Umbrella in front in of his lane can also intercept cabbages that would have been thrown to adjacent lanes and boost them.</color>

plants.name: Matschlonapult
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Squash is heavy, but too soft. Melons are heavy too, but too fragile. Now those problems are solved. Or possibly combined.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Projectiles crush zombies like a Squash, then shatter like a Melon, dealing splash damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120 (Squash)/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles deal area crush damage on landing, then break shortly after, dealing splash damage with fall-off similar to Melon-pult.</color>

plants.name: Kirschmus
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Even among Squashes, Cherry Squash is famously short-tempered and quick to explode. "Try carrying something that heavy on your back," he grumbles. Other Squashes are less concerned about the temper, and more curious how he could jump so high and so far with the thing on his back.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A very explosive Squash.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 1800 (3×3, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing, triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion.</color>

plants.name: Matsch des Grauens
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Squash rarely speaks to anyone on the lawn. It silently moves from place to place, leaving craters behind. Rumor has it that it was originally supposed to be deployed under "dire circumstances" but somehow escaped containment.

- Edited by cassidy</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>An extremely explosive Squash, and prone to causing collateral damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 1800 (5×5, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing, triggers a Doom-shroom explosion that leaves a crater on the landing spot; destroying all plants on that tile.</color>

plants.name: Buttermüffel
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Come on, have a taste of my fresh butter!" Blubber-shroom says proudly, showing off his new recipe. "If you don't like it, just shake your head," he adds. Everyone seems to be diggin' it, or at least they are completely motionless.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Sprays butter from the top of its cap onto nearby zombies.

<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>An area within a 2.2-tile radius</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not actively target zombies. When damaged or manually tapped and if there are zombies within attack range, it performs an attack.
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, loses 30 max HP (and current HP), throwing one pat of Butter at every zombie in range, dealing 40 damage and immobilizing them for 4s.</color>

plants.name: Dupli-Triplinator
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You two have already taken turns for three whole minutes, now it's my turn!" The three heads of the Multipeater have been competing for shared items since childhood, from marbles, to comic books, to a limited-edition commando badge carved from peas.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Can switch between three attack modes, allowing flexible allocation of firepower.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×6(or n)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has three attack modes that can be switched by tapping on it; targeting behavior changes accordingly:
<color=black>•</color> 1. Standard Mode: Fires 2 peas each into his own lane and the 2 adjacent lanes;
<color=black>•</color> 2. Spread Mode: Fires 1 peas each into every lane (if the map has fewer than 6 lanes, the damage from missing shots is evenly redistributed among the remaining shots);
<color=black>•</color> 3. Focus Mode: Fires 6 peas each into his own lane.</color>

plants.name: Sonnenwind
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar Blover always wears a gentle smile, often saying, "Clear skies and a spring breeze filled with sunshine - how pleasant!" Sadly, zombies don't understand this beauty. What she blows out isn't a soft spring wind, it's pure solar wind.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Capable of blowing out a large number of Sun shots.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10×72</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spins its leaves and fires two spirals totaling 72 Sun Shots. Each shot drops 5 Sun upon hitting a target and can be buffed by Infernowood to deal 40 damage and drop 15 Sun instead.</color>

plants.name: Pustekürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The three Puff-shroom Pumpkin brothers are well-loved, well-behaved kids: quiet, orderly, and never quarrelsome. Their only hobby is trying to piece together the pumpkin puzzle on top of their heads, though unfortunately, they have never quite succeeded.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>The more Puff-shrooms in the Puff-kin, the stronger the protection!

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Restores 50 HP every 3s. Starts out at 1/4 max HP.
<color=black>•</color> At 1/3 max HP or more, gains a 50% incoming damage reduction.
<color=black>•</color> At 2/3 max HP or more, absorbs damage for the plant inside.</color>

plants.name: Stinkkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I can attack in both forward and backward directions," says Fumy Pumpkin confidently. "I'm a bidirectional Fume-shroom." However, he doesn't appear to have noticed that he's facing a different direction from everyone else.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Can attack like a Fume-shroom… though the direction seems a little off.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Targets from his own tile, up to 3 tiles both above and below</color>

plants.name: Sonnenmatsch
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar Squash's favorite thing to do is gently pat the petals on his head with his leaf, then boast proudly to other Squashes: "This is what Sun-powered shampoo does. Just look how smooth my hair is." Luckily for him, the other Squashes are all very serious and never tease him, so he still doesn't know he's sporting a classic receding hairline.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Can consume Sun to remain on the lawn after squashing.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing or dying, consumes 50 + 25 * (Number of previous revivals) Sun to remain on the tile of the landing spot/revive. If this fails, 50 Sun is refunded.</color>

plants.name: Melonenkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Ha ha! Guess where my eyebrows are!" Melon Pumpkin laughs at the audience. A famous rooftop magician, he excels at all kinds of tricks, including making half of his eyes disappear. Of course, his proudest illusion is the Great Melon Transformation. To this day, no one has ever seen how he hides a watermelon inside a Melon-pult's bucket.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Throws bonus watermelons when protecting a catapult-type plant.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/?s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time the catapult plant inside attacks, it simultaneously launches an additional watermelon.</color>

plants.name: Sprungmine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>You've seen Squashes growing on vines, but have you ever seen one sprouting from the ground itself? Don't be fooled, as Potato Masher is simply mashed potatoes shaped like a Squash. But don't you dare laugh at how short he is. If he hears you, he'll make you even shorter than he is.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Produces Potato Mashes that can squash zombies.

<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts out armed by default. Generates a Potato Mash on the spot when a zombie enters his targeting range, then burrows underground for 15s to arm again.
<color=black>•</color> Potato Mash has the same effect and damage as Squash, but with a larger targeting range.</color>

plants.name: Springmine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Don't let his small size fool you - his ambitions are anything but small. "I won't live under the Masher's protection forever. I'm jumping out to find my own life." With that, he leaps forward and crushes the zombie in his way. Maybe one day, he too will find a pit of his own, just like the Masher did.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Similar to Squash, but much easier to trigger.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>1.5 tiles to the left; 2.5 tiles to the right</color>

plants.name: Unheilsknoblauch
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At one Zombie Garlic-Eating Championship, Doom Garlic was served as the final course. The result: three of the ten contestants withdrew, five were rushed to the hospital, and the remaining two exploded on the spot. With no remaining competitors, Doom Garlic himself was declared the champion of that year's event.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Causes the zombies that bit it to explode upon death.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Inflicts Irradiated debuff on zombies that bite it and curses them. Cursed zombies explode on death in a 1.5-tile radius for 300 damage.
<color=black>•</color> Inflicts Poison debuff and 1 Poison point on zombies that bite it.
<color=black>•</color> When Irradiated debuff and Poison debuff are active simultaneously on a zombie, the Poison duration becomes infinite.</color>

plants.name: Starburstpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>When Starburst-shroom's star-shaped cap hits a zombie, it releases star projectiles, greatly improving projectile efficiency. "Actually, if the backward-fired star were optimized as well, the efficiency could be even higher." One of his comrades commented while dodging the returning projectile.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires piercing star caps that split into five stars on contact.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>0 + 20×5×(0-3)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>The Star cap itself deals no damage and can pierce twice. Each time it contacts a zombie, it releases 1 star projectile in each of 5 directions, each dealing 20 damage.</color>

plants.name: Furchttöpfchen
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At school, Scaredy Flower Pot always curls up and avoids interacting with others. Because the mushrooms he grows are fewer than those of his classmates, he believes he is inferior. What his fear prevents him from noticing is that his classmates are actually envious - the mushrooms he grows are the most delicious of all.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Give boosts based on the value of the plant placed on top.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Grants the plant placed on top an attack damage bonus equal to [0.04 × (that plant's Sun cost)]%, up to 20%.
<color=black>•</color> If the plant on top is a Scaredy-type mushroom, the attack bonus becomes 2×(base bonus + 10%), up to 60%.
<color=black>•</color> Becomes frightened when zombies are present within a 3×3 area and stops providing attack bonus while frightened. After leaving the frightened state, the attack bonus gradually recovers over 3s.</color>

plants.name: Muffellampe
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Every plant I see is wearing sunglasses," Ray-shroom grumbles. "It's ridiculous, so pretentious!" In the end, Ray-shroom chalks it up to some inexplicable trend, while the other plants agree that staring directly at an ultra-high-power laser emitter is obviously bad for your eyesight…</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires a piercing laser ray. Damage falls off with distance and increases with Lumos.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Fires across the entire lane with unlimited pierce.
<color=black>•</color> Each Lumos level increases damage by 0.5×.
<color=black>•</color> Damage increases by 1.6×(5 - column distance to the target). At Lumos level 3 or higher, this instead becomes 0.8×(10 - column distance).</color>

plants.name: Kohldrohne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After years of mindlessly throwing cabbages, seeing the world at that height really makes you think. What if those cabbages had a life? Hopes and dreams? Families? Children? All of those questions run through Cabbage Dropper's leafy mind.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Provides close-range air support by dropping cabbages.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant.</color>

plants.name: Maisdrohne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butter Fly signed up for the Garden Variety Show, hoping to play a UFO on stage, but it never made the cut. He just kept dropping corn and butter everywhere, drawing fierce opposition from the ground crew, and even causing the director who supported him to take a nasty fall.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Provides close-range air support by dropping corn kernels or butter.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant. Has a 25% chance to drop butter, dealing 40 damage.</color>

plants.name: Sturzmelone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Other melons call him lazy, but Fall Melon insists he's efficient. "Just let gravity do the work! Throwing things is exhausting!" He seems to completely ignore the fact that this also shortens his range.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Provides close-range air support by dropping melons.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant.</color>

plants.name: Stinkmine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After accepting a brand partnership offer from Potato Mine, Starch-shroom quit his bakery job. "Joining the explosive-making industry was the best decision I've ever made," says Starch-shroom. "Spraying starch straight from your mouth is way more efficient than fermenting bread!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>The fume he sprays carries a strong potato scent, sometimes even explosive!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 10th attack, triggers a Potato Mine explosion that deals 300 damage at the position of each zombie hit.</color>

plants.name: Maismatschapult
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butternut-pult was never good at biology. He's always believed that the idea of "apical dominance" is wrong, but he's learned to keep that opinion to himself, not because he's embarrassed about his grades, but because he doesn’t want anyone to realize he's a corn with an underdeveloped tip.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Thrown projectiles slam zombies like a Squash, with a chance to butter the ones that get crushed.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles deal area squash damage when they land. Has a 25% chance to throw a Butter Squash, dealing 60 damage and applying 4s of Butter stun to up to 3 damaged targets.</color>

plants.name: Oje-Mine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As the head chef of a French fry restaurant, Crater-tot runs a tight kitchen and is known for his strict, no-nonsense management. But behind his successful spud career lies a personal struggle: his explosive temper means he can no longer make delicious fries.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Shatters in a devastating explosion, scattering five Potato Mines that instantly arm on landing.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. When it explodes, it also triggers a Doom-shroom effect, then throws potato chunks onto 5 empty tiles. Each chunk creates a fully armed Potato Mine as soon as it lands.</color>

plants.name: Hypnostern
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Zodiac-shroom worries that the loose tuft of fuzz on top of his cap makes him look silly, though most zombies would never understand why that bothers him.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Zombies that bite him become hypnotized, turning into moving star launchers.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When bitten, hypnotizes the zombie and disappears, causing it to fire stars in a spiral: 60 volleys (300 total star projectiles).</color>

plants.name: Matsch-Erbse
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Should I jump up and smash zombies, or should I just be a proper shooter?" That question haunted Pea Squash throughout his entire adolescence. In the end, he chose the more traditional Squash lifestyle, but every time he hits the ground, those little green bumps on his body reflexively fire peas anyway.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Bursts into a storm of peas when it slams down.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When it lands, releases 3 rings of pea projectiles (108 peas total).</color>

plants.name: Silber-Eispilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Ruthless. Cold-blooded. Those are the labels people stick on Silver Ice-shroom, even other Ice-shrooms think he's too icy. Silver Ice-shroom doesn't care. His success comes from being cold-hearted; anyone who isn't ruthless enough simply can't survive in the cold-chain logistics business.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>An Ice-shroom coated in silver frost.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Freezes for 1 second longer than a normal Ice-shroom.</color>

plants.name: Gold-Eispilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>A monopolist of the cold-chain logistics industry, Golden Ice-shroom can sway the temperature of the market with just a light sprinkle of coins. After years in the business, his wealth and fame are beyond counting, and his life is complete… except for the fact that he still can't cure his facial paralysis.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A stable, gold-plated Ice-shroom that brings extreme cold through money.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Triggers an Ice-shroom effect once on appearance (does not disappear afterwards).</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Costs 3000 Coins, Cooldown: 2s; repeats the following effects 4 times on targets within a 2.2-tile radius:
-Deals 200 damage, applies Chill and 25 Cryo point, and reduces the target's Cryo cap by 100.
-Fires an icicle at each target dealing 20 damage. Icicles deal 2× damage to Chilled zombies and 4× damage to frozen zombies.</color>

plants.name: Stinkschleuder
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Table tennis is a shared passion of both plants and zombies, and Rebound Shroom is a household name in the zombie world, having defeated countless graveyard champions. By reporting opponents for the foul of returning the ball with their heads, he has claimed gold medals in over a dozen Plant-Zombie Table Tennis Championships, while his not-too-bright opponents have never noticed that he commits the very same foul himself.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Treats projectiles as table tennis balls, batting them back and forth continuously toward zombies' heads.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When a lobbed projectile in the same lane hits a zombie in front, it will rebound toward Rebound-shroom and then continue bouncing back and forth between the two.
<color=black>•</color> Only one projectile can be bounced at a time; the bounce height gradually decreases until it hits the ground.
<color=black>•</color> Does not bounce squash projectiles or projectiles that can already bounce on their own.</color>

plants.name: Matschchen
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>They're just three kids pestering you for candy. The only unusual thing is that if you refuse their request, you might feel a bit of "pressure."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Energetic little squashes that hop around and smash enemies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>1 tile to the left and right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Can be planted 3 times in one tile.
<color=black>•</color> Smashes once every 1s and does not disappear after smashing; when not targeting, jumps back to its original tile.
<color=black>•</color> Vulnerable to zombie attack for 0.6s after each smash.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to crush. When crushed, takes 500 damage every 0.02s. When smashed, takes damage equal to the corresponding damage a hypnotized zombie would take when smashed.</color>

plants.name: Katastrophenkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Pumpkin is always advertising his services as being great for healthier-looking skin, but plant inspectors often complain that his treatments are dangerously radioactive.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Channels the power of Doom-shroom into the plants inside.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains 1% charge every 0.5s; enters the field with a starting charge between 80%-95% randomly.
<color=black>•</color> When charge meter is full (100%), can consume all charge to transform one plant on his tile into a fusion of that plant and Doom-shroom (the resulting plant must not be an Odyssey fusion).</color>

plants.name: Stacheltopf
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every plant that's spent time with Spike Pot complains that he's far too enthusiastic and has no sense of personal boundaries. Only Obsidian Spike-nut doesn't mind, and the reason is simple: Spike Pot is the only one willing to help de-rust Obsidian Spike-nut's razor-sharp shell.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Has Spikeweed traits and enhances the defenses of Spike-nut plants.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Inherits traits from Spikeweed (ignored by biting zombies and pops tires).
<color=black>•</color> Grants 50% damage reduction to Spike-nut and Obsidian Spike-nut on him.
<color=black>•</color> Becomes anti-crush if the plant above is an Obsidian Spike-nut.</color>

plants.name: Leuchterbse
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Lumos Pea started out as a kid who loved shining laser pointers at people. Later, Pharos Umbrella taught him how to use that trick on zombies instead.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires high-frequency targeted lasers; absorbs Lumos energy to increase power.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 10% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

plants.name: Matschdrohne
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>By harnessing gravitational potential energy, floating Squashes can unleash devastating slams with ease: making the exaggerated wind-up before attacking seem unnecessary. "Not unnecessary at all," explains Squash Drone. "I'm shooing away the ladybugs resting on my leaves, so I don't hit them by accident."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Repeatedly slams down on zombies beneath him.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100/2s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>Current tile</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Flying plant. When a zombie is in range, smashes the zombie below repeatedly.</color>

plants.name: Eisbergsalat
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You have no idea how terrifying that place was," Coldslaw says, still shaken. "A land of extreme cold, where countless plants were frozen forever. If I hadn't risked my life to open the door back outside, we vegetables would've all died in there." Oh, he's talking about his adventure inside Dave's refrigerator again.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs frozen cabbages and attacks faster when hitting frozen enemies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>On hitting a Frozen zombie, the projectile can bounce once, and Coldslaw's attack speed is greatly increased for 3s. This effect can only trigger again 1.5s after it ends.</color>

plants.name: Eismais
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>To freeze the perfect butter, Cobsicle made a special trip to Siberia. Now, its butter is as smooth as marble; heavy, hard, beautiful, and makes a satisfying thud when smashed on a zombie's head.'</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs frozen kernels and butter.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 25% chance to throw a frozen butter stick that freezes zombies for 4 seconds.</color>

plants.name: Klein-Tang
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Tingle Kelp is extremely vigilant. It lives alone, foraging only in shallow waters. When necessary, it even hides beneath zombies to evade predators. It sleeps with one eye open—no easy feat for a plant with only one eye.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>When coming in contact with a zombie, Tingle Kelp explodes and attaches itself to other zombies to multiply.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20 × 30</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When a zombie comes into contact with Tingle Kelp, it will burst into 30 kelp projectiles that inflict 1 Tangle value before disappearing. If a zombie is killed by the kelp projectile, an extra Tingle Kelp will spawn on that tile (if possible).</color>

plants.name: Quetschkohlapult
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>"Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to my exact specifications, and it's massively boosted my throwing efficiency!" Lettuce-pult exclaimed excitedly. "Oh, the battle is about to begin." With that, he leaped into a larger version of himself. Moments later, he heard the opponent say, "Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to..."</color>
plants.info:
Lettuce-pult can launch tinier versions of itself, unmasking its layers to attack more zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Lobs a mini Lettuce-pult that deals AOE crushing damage upon landing, then lobs 2 smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 50% of the original damage before disappearing. The smaller Lettuce-pults lob 2 even smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 25% of the original damage and disappear immediately before disappearing itself.</color>

plants.name: Triplanterne
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Triplantern's favorite number is three. Triple the light, triple the vision, even triple the salary. With savings that generous, he can afford triple the snacks, neatly stored in his triple lamp cases. The triple things that he hates are triple the zombies, triple the waves and triple the gacha levels.</color>
plants.info:
Provides triple the Lumos of a normal Plantern and splits lasers into three.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Provides 3 Lumos levels in a 3×3 area.
<color=black>•</color> Lumos Cactus and Ray-shroom anti-ground lasers that pass through will create two additional lasers in the same lane, each dealing 30 damage.</color>

plants.name: Hypnotopf
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Hypno Pot is well-liked by everyone. Plants, zombies, even mischievous little beetles are all her friends. She works at a mushroom nursery, and in her free time she's a proud member of the Zombuddies Club, often sharing her handmade rainbow clay during holidays.</color>
plants.info:
The charm within the pot nurtures hypnotized zombies.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Grants hypnotized zombies on its tile 33% Damage Reduction and heals 1 HP every 0.04s. When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and reverts back to a Flower Pot.</color>

plants.name: Rebeamer
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The weekly Pool Light Festival is an important social event for Rebeamer. Before heading out, it carefully adjusts its lamp hat, the leaves under the brim not only make it look stylish, but also give its firefly friends a place to rest after the party.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires two high-frequency lasers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10×2/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 20% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 2 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

plants.name: Split Beam
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's my turn to wear the hat." "But the strap is under my chin."The two heads of the Lumen Relay Shooter argue constantly. Even the Pool Light Festival can't distract them - the only thing that stops the argument is when they start fighting over the eyebrows instead.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Receives laser energy from the left and fires high-frequency lasers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> The right head functions like a Beamshooter.
<color=black>•</color> The left head can receive Lumos energy from beamshooter-family plants in the same lane (not in directly adjacent tile).
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

plants.name: Gatling Beam
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Beam shines brilliantly on the battlefield, often earning four times the credit. Though its glow makes it an easy target, it never backs down. Wounds within the light are a warrior's badge of honor.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires four high-frequency lasers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10×4/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 40% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 4 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

plants.name: Jalapeñito
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Each little Bell Pepper may be small and insignificant on its own, but together they pack serious heat. That's why they like to stick in groups. Other plants even rate them by size: mild, medium, and extra hot.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Small body, fiery temper.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>600 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Explodes when zombies get close, triggering a Jalapeno effect with less damage.</color>

plants.name: Herb-senkanone
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Despite the name, Poison Pea is a chef with a strong signature style. He insists every customer try its specialty, fried peas with garlic powder. The smell alone brings zombies flooding with memories: childhood, family, home… and plenty of tears.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires garlic peas that cause poisoned zombies to release toxins, forming a toxic cloud.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20× the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>

plants.name: Knobinator
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Fight! Fight! Attack! Attack!" Poison Repeater lives with passion and poison. Nothing distracts it, not zombies, not vampires, not even pushy salesmen.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires two garlic peas at once.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

plants.name: Knallknoblauch
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Bouncing shots are a must-have skill for modern Split Peas, but Split Poison did not bother to learn it. Nor does he had to. He can simply fire garlic peas into the house behind it, and sooner or later someone will throw them right back.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires garlic peas both forwards and backwards.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

plants.name: MG-Knoblauch
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At the neighborhood potluck, renowned linguist Gatling Poison proudly served a "traditional recipe" of 'pois' and 'poisson'. It tasted excellent, except everybody got food poisoning afterwards. To this day he still insists the 'poison' was part of the 'Gift'.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires four garlic peas at once.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>

plants.name: Lötlampenpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Blowtorch-shroom made a name for himself by quickly cooking peas into rich pea paste and turning them into "pea tarts." His skills are famous, but so is his terrible business sense. His business goes bankrupt at the rate of one restaurant per year, mostly because he burns through far too many peas just to maintain his hairstyle.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Burns incoming peas, compressing them into a burst of flame.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not attack on its own.
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs passing peas. Every 1s, exhales a piercing flame 4 tiles forward. Damage equals the total damage of absorbed peas, up to 300.
<color=black>•</color> Melts Snow Peas into normal peas.</color>

plants.name: Kieferbrecher
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"So hungry, so hungry, so hungry! I'm starving!" Jawbreaker shouts as he lunges at zombies ahead. No matter how much he eats, it's never enough. Oh look - a Gargantuar! Finally, a proper meal… Wait, that might've been too much.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Gluttonous Squash that keeps squashing when fed.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> On landing, attempts to devour one zombie caught underneath. Still deals damage to zombies that are not eaten.
<color=black>•</color> On a successful devour, returns to the field on the same tile, otherwise he disappears.</color>

plants.name: Zunderstank
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The fresh aroma of garlic is soothing, while the blaze of fire elevates it to another level entirely. Stenchwood takes a deep breath, lost in this intoxicating scent, and feels regret that other plants cannot appreciate such beauty.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Cauterizes passing peas, greatly enhancing their toxicity.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Affects specific projectiles that pass through:
<color=black>-</color> Peas: +10 Damage, becomes Poison Pea;
<color=black>-</color> Poison Peas: Damage ×2, becomes Venom Peas that also deal Splash damage.</color>

plants.name: Platschkürbis
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Splash works as a lifeguard at a seaside resort. Everyone is amazed that such a heavy body can still glide effortlessly across the water. When asked about it, he always replies, "That's not something easy to do." In truth, he floats thanks to a buoyant balloon hat, whose manufacturer Hopcap went bankrupt ten years ago.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Aquatic squash.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>

plants.name: Stinktus
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The fog is too thick! I can't breathe!" Saguaro-shroom exclaims, stretching his body to raise his breathing pores above the fog. "That's better… though I can't go any higher, or the air will soon be out of oxygen!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires heavy fume to strike low-flying enemies. Can extend to focus on aerial targets.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Click to switch between different attack modes:
<color=black>-</color> Low Altitude: hits both ground and air;
<color=black>-</color> High Altitude: ×4 damage, anti-air only.</color>

plants.name: Hypnofeuer
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As a rising star of the poolside variety scene, Hypnowood quickly gained a huge following of zombies and plants alike. Her fiery charm and helpful nature became her trademark. But like many public figures, she is plagued by rumors: plastic surgery and excessive use of cosmetics have always followed her.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Summons Gatling Pea Zombies from its flames.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a hypnotized Gatling Pea Zombie for every 60 projectiles ignited.
<color=black>•</color> Hypno Peas count as 4 projectiles.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, and reverts to Torchwood.
<color=black>•</color> Affects the following projectiles:
<color=black>-</color> Peas: Ignited for +20 damage;
<color=black>-</color> Hypno Peas: Ignited for +30 damage;
<color=black>-</color> Snow Peas: Reverts to Peas.</color>

plants.name: Mief-Tang
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Grapple Kelp has a unique sense of art, believing that absolute chaos is the highest form of beauty. His untamed curls have never been groomed, instead growing into a style of their own. Because of this, he has been absent from every underwater zombie cleanup mission.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Extends tendrils to repeatedly strike enemies in front.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/3s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks all zombies within 4.5 tiles in front three times. Each hit applies 1 Tangle Stack and triggers these effects:
<color=black>-</color> 1st hit: +1 extra stack;
<color=black>-</color> 2nd hit: Deals additional damage equal to 5×(current stacks on the zombie);
<color=black>-</color> 3rd hit: knockback.</color>

plants.name: Pustepilz-Verteiler: Stinkpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black></color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A mushroom cluster formed from Puff-shrooms dispersed by a Fume-shroom.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Plants down a Fume-shroom in place of the Puff-shroom and spawns Puff-shrooms in equal intervals ahead (decreasing per tile). The more Puff-shrooms consumed in fusion, the more will be spawned.</color>

plants.name: Pustepilz-Verteiler: Angsthasenpilz
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black></color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A mushroom cluster formed from Puff-shrooms dispersed by a Scaredy-shroom.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Plants down a Scaredy-shroom in place of the Puff-shroom and spawns Puff-shrooms evenly across front, upper, and lower adjacent tiles (prioritizing front). The more Puff-shrooms consumed in fusion, the more will be spawned.</color>

plants.name: Kimchipult
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thanks to his mastery of chili sauce, his Korean restaurant is always booming. Its owner, Kimchi-pult, is just as fiery, bold, passionate, and intense. There's only one thing to remember when eating his food: once you're full, leave quickly… or he'll serve you another round.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Hurls spicy-hot cabbages that explode into smaller cabbages on impact.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>On hit, projectile splits into smaller projectiles across a 3×3 area (1/3 damage each), all applying Enflamed debuff before dealing damage.</color>

plants.name: Waterloo-pult
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the hunter of the night," he declares. His dark skin blends perfectly into darkness, but his glowing red eyes often give him away. Still, Damage-pult refuses to wear sunglasses, calling it "the gaze of death"… though in truth, he just can't figure out how to take his contact off.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Launches high-damage cabbages that trigger explosions on Irradiated targets.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800/15s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When hitting Irradiated zombies, the projectile causes a small splash explosion dealing 1/3 damage without falloff.</color>

plants.name: Popcornapult
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Our popcorn is made from 100% natural ingredients!" Popcorn-pult proudly advertises. However, customers often question his claim, mostly because his butter seems permanently burning-hot and impossible to cool.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Throws magma butter that ignite enemies and empower fire-type plants.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles apply Enflamed debuff before dealing damage.
<color=black>•</color> Has 25% chance to launch Magma Butter (50 damage): applies 4s stun, triggers a full-lane Jalapeno effect with 50 damage, and grants fire plants (Jalapeno fusions) +50% attack damage for 6s (Odyssey ones +25% instead).</color>

plants.name: Eismine
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the true star of the battlefield," Ice Mine thinks. "And a star always makes his entrance at the very last moment." Before the grand review, he even buries himself in cool soil to rest, but not without making sure his perfect hairstyle stays untouched above ground.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Releases condensed icy gas that triggers chain ice explosions from even the smallest contact.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>On arming and detonation, triggers an ice blast that freezes zombies in a 3×3 area for 4s, dealing 1/3 damage, and triggers secondary smaller ice blasts in adjacent tiles containing zombies.</color>

plants.name: Erbsen-Sonnenblume (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Actually, the Sunflower behind me is my sister," Solar-shooter explained to everyone. "We've been inseparable since birth. She loves producing Sun, and I destroy zombies on her behalf." But everyone knows the truth: the cheerful Pea brother is a total siscon. After all, every zombie that gets near his sister mysteriously ends up vaporized by sunlight.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Solar-shooter can fire Sun shots that occasionally produce Sun.

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
