<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Every third shot drops 5 Sun when hitting targets.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(80 Sun) Attack Damage & Speed +20%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(200 Sun) Attack Damage +200%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(200 Sun) Attack Speed +100%</color>

plants.name: Sommersonnenpilz (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>A seasoned sunlight banker, Sunrise-shroom offers high interest on your deposits."You chose a time deposit," he says sternly to a frustrated Twin Solar-nut. "Withdrawals aren't allowed just yet."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A visionary sun producer that absorbs and multiplies nearby sun, paying out in bursts.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs dropped Sun within a 5×5 area, multiplies their value by ×1.3, and stores them.
<color=black>•</color> Releases as much Sun as possible in batches of 25 along with the next production.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(60 Sun) Sun Production Speed +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(150 Sun) Sun Production Speed +200%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(150 Sun) Sun Value Multiplier ×2</color>

plants.name: Explod-o-Kanone (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Meet Explode-o-shooter, the ultimate plant killer. He's more irritable than ever—who would've thought the warm and friendly Cherryshooter would swallow another special cherry? Don't push your luck with him. That cherry stuck in his throat might just be his next shot—his face is already turning red!</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Shoots out explosive cherries that explode on impact.

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Immune to explosive cherries and deals AoE damage.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(160 Sun) Attack Damage +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(400 Sun) Attack Damage +100%, Explosion Radius +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(400 Sun) Attack Speed +200%</color>

plants.name: Sternnuss (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Star-nut lives under a rock and rarely moves. It's not because he's lazy, but because he's got standards. He'll only act if invited by a certain square friend to jellyfishing… or to prank a cephalopodic neighbor.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A reactive defender that counters with little stars.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Fires five 10-damage stars in all directions when damaged.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(80 Sun) HP and Max Robustheit +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(200 Sun) HP +200%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(200 Sun) Regen +100% (100 HP/3s)</color>

plants.name: Solar-Mine (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Stop at red lights, slow down at yellow lights, and obey traffic rules!" Solar Mine frequently warns zombies. But to the zombies, all they see is the disgusting green hue before them. He clutches his green leaves and pouts, wishing for more sunshine. "After all, sunshine is what fuels us all!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Solar Mine produces Sun until and after its explosion.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Drops 50 Sun on explosion.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(10 Sun) Explosion Damage +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(25 Sun) Explosion Radius +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(25 Sun) Explosion Damage +100%</color>

plants.name: Schnee-Stinkmorchel (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Dreaming of a career as a physicist, the Frost Gloom-shroom dedicates his days to unraveling the complexities of the world, avoiding contact with other plants. "Why do I have multiple strings of icicles sprouting from my head?" he muses, the latest question occupying his thoughts. He's oddly adamant about calling them "strings."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Releases cold fumes around that can freeze zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>5/3.8s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks apply Chill.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(80 Sun) Attack Speed +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(200 Sun) Attacks add 10 Cryo points
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(200 Sun) Chill Duration ×2</color>

plants.name: Kirschnapper (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Ever since her drink with Cherry Bomb, Chomper has been constantly "buzzing." She turned into an absolute menace every meal. The sound of chewing transformed into explosive pops as plates and bowls flew everywhere, leaving everyone unwilling to dine with her. After a show of hands, Cherry Chomper ended up eating in the yard… at least she no longer has to buy new tableware.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Produces a cherry explosion upon eating a zombie.

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Creates a 3×3 Cherry explosion with 1000 damage in the tile directly ahead on successful biting.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(200 Sun) Explosion Damage +20%, Digestion Time -10s
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(500 Sun) Explosion Damage +100%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(500 Sun) Digestion Time -50% (15s)</color>

plants.name: Zwiebelwatt (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Amp-nion thought his moment had come — after all, who else had eaten lightning over a hundred times? Surely, he was destined to play the Frankenstein monster! But when he received the script, his dreams short-circuited. He wasn't a star. He wasn't even a sidekick. He was just Dr. Stanley's lightning rod...</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Attacks approaching zombies with lightning rays!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>5×5</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Idle Amp-nions in range will channel power to the attacking one, each boosting the damage by 150%.
<color=black>•</color> Each shot can arc to other zombies to deal 1/3 the damage, up to a maximum of 3 zombies.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(120 Sun) Attack Damage +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(300 Sun) Arcing now deals full damage
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(300 Sun) Attack Damage + 300% but no longer arcs</color>

plants.name: Erbsenpilz (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Don't let my size fool you; even a small body can contain a lot of energy," Pea-shroom cautions those who underestimate him. "We all began as tiny mushrooms, making progress a little at a time. With dedication to a sunny breakfast, you can become just like me."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Pea-shroom shoots further than Puff-shroom.

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant, stackable.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(20 Sun) Attack Damage + 50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(50 Sun) Attack Damage +100%, now fires ignited small peas
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(50 Sun) Attack Damage +200%</color>

plants.name: Sonnenpilz (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sun-shroom hates sun. He hates it so much that when it builds up in his system, he spits it out as fast as he can. He just won't abide it. To him, sun is crass.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Sun-shrooms give small sun at first and normal sun later.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>5→15/25s</color>
<color=black>Growth Time: </color><color=#8B0000>120s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant, stackable.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(10 Sun) Sun Production Time → 16.67s
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(25 Sun) Grows immediately and produces Sun
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(25 Sun) Now produces 2 Suns at once</color>

plants.name: Rußpilz (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Soot-shroom, the misanthropic workaholic, can't stand the sight of zombies—too much of a distraction. He's got a small stash of bullets, but they're more than lethal enough. "Don't bother me unless it's urgent. If you want them dead, just shoot them yourself." Still, his sharp efficiency keeps everyone looking up to him.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Soot-shroom can destroy most zombies in front of it.

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1000/60s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Click manually in the Upgrade Menu to attack all zombies in the row in front.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(200 Sun) Attack Damage +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(500 Sun) Attack Damage +200%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(500 Sun) Attack CD -50%</color>

plants.name: Grabfresser (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Despite Grave Buster's fearsome appearance, he wants everyone to know that he loves kittens and spends his off hours volunteering at a local zombie rehabilitation center. "It's just the right thing to do," he says.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Plant Grave Busters on statues to remove the statues.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Can bust Statues.</color>
<color=black>Sun Statue Mechanic: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Statues block straight-shooting projectiles from plants and have 1000 HP each.
<color=black>•</color> Statues can only be damaged by projectiles or Grave Busters.
<color=black>•</color>Sunflower Statues drop 100 Sun when destroyed, Sun-shroom Statues drop 50.</color>

plants.name: Mutpilz (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Courage fills me, no fear remains~ Whether it's spring, fall, winter, or summer~" Gutsy-shroom no longer shrinks in the face of zombies. "I used to tremble, but Senior Fume-shroom told me, 'If a zombie gets near, spray your spores. Hiding won't solve anything.'"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Gutsy-shroom is ready to take on the zombies, near or far!

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2/1.5s (Long range); 20/1.5s (Short range, piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Shoots 2 spores at once. When zombies get within 4 tiles in range, sprays piercing fumes instead.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(80 Sun) Attack Damage & Speed +20%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(200 Sun) Attack Damage +200%, now permanently shoots spores
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(200 Sun) Attack Damage +100%, range for spraying fumes ×2</color>

plants.name: Frierblatt (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Breeze Blover is a -4°C air conditioner. When his chilly breeze blows, it feels like stepping straight into winter. Even Snow Pea is frozen, the cold wind actually froze his own projectiles. What could possibly be colder than that? Answer: The atmosphere after Coldsnap Bean's told one of his totally tone deaf jokes.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Blover of a freezing breeze that constantly applies chill.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Lasts for 10s before disappearing.
<color=black>•</color> Deals 1 damage and applies 20 Cryo points to all zombies on the lawn.
<color=black>•</color> Converts all snow peas on screen to polar ice peas.</color>

plants.name: Todesstern (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I could destroy almost the entire planet if I wanted to," boasts Death Star, "and they'd all blame it on the biggest star in the sky..."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Transforms himself into a Doom Meteor and crashes into the ground.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Disappears after 3s and summons a Doom Meteor that deals 1800 area damage on impact and splits into 180 spore stars each dealing 20 damage.</color>

plants.name: Kugelkrug (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Coach, I want to play basketball." Drippy Pitcher has always dreamed of becoming a basketball star. He practices shooting day and night without rest. He has two advantages: first, he kind of looks like a basketball hoop; second, he has an endless supply of basketballs to practice with. For heaven's sake, don't ask what those balls are made of.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs droplet shells that bounce between the zombie and other Drippy Pitchers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>Range: </color><color=#8B0000>Within 2 tiles in all four directions</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles rebound to nearby other Drippy Pitchers on hit, prompting them to immediately attack twice.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(120 Sun) Attack Damage & Speed +20%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(300 Sun) Attack Damage +200%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(300 Sun) Attack Speed +100%, projectiles can now rebound to self</color>

plants.name: Seerosenblatt (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Lily Pad never complains. Lily Pad never wants to know what's going on. Put a plant on top of Lily Pad, he won't say a thing. Does he have startling opinions or shocking secrets? Nobody knows. Lily Pad keeps it all inside.</color></size>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Non-aquatic plants can be planted on it.</color></size>

plants.name: Matschnuss (TD)
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Dragged from a kids' playground by his stem and dumped on the lawn, Squash-nut was rejected for being a deformed rubber ball. Now, furious and bumpy, he bounces wildly, yelling: "I'm gonna play all I want! ALL I WANT!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A bouncy nut who's all tantrum and impact.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/1.5s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Bounces in his tile when a zombie gets close, dealing splash damage on each landing. Does not block zombies while airborne.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(30 Sun) Attack Damage +50%

plants.name: Minenfeld (TD)
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Threetato Mine loves playing tricks underground. It shoots out surprises not once, not twice, but thrice—like a cheeky prankster with a never-ending stash of boom. Watch your step, or you might get a triple whammy that’ll blow your boots off.

- Written by Mrs. Draco</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Threetato Mine resurfaces after exploding and fires potatoes across three lanes.

<color=blue>Reversible by pressing R</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> When armed, explodes on contact, dealing 3600 damage, knocks back for 1 tile and retreats into the ground.
<color=black>•</color> Re-emerges 15s after exploding. Explodes and disappears immediately upon contact with vehicles.</color>
<color=black>Upgrades: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>• Basic Upgrade: </color>(160 Sun) Projectile Damage +50%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 1: </color>(400 Sun) Projectile Damage +200%
<color=black>• Elite Upgrade Path 2: </color>(400 Sun) Now unleashes an Ultimate move every 60s, firing 250 shots straight ahead over 5s, plus 500 more in a 0-45° spread</color>
